articleTitle: Detection of Line-to-Ground and Line-to-Line Faults Based on Fault Voltage Analysis in PV System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Line-to-ground (LG) faults and line-to-line (LL) faults reduce the operating efficiency of photovoltaic (PV) systems and even lead to severe accidents such as fire hazards. Since the maximum power point tracking controller can reduce the fault current, the conventional protection devices such as overcurrent protection device and grounding protection device can not be triggered. Therefore, in this paper, a voltage-sensing-based technique is proposed to accurately detect and locate LG faults and LL faults by analyzing the fault voltage. The voltage characteristics under various fault conditions are analyzed to develop the LG and LL fault detection and location algorithm. The simulation results verify that the proposed technique can detect and locate the LG and LL faults effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Oil Leakage Detection in Power Plant Oil Depot Pipeline Based on Improved YOLO v5
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The pipelines in power plants are densely distributed and some of them are seriously aging, especially in key areas such as oil depots, once the leakage phenomenon occurs, serious production safety accidents will occur. In order to detect and warn of pipeline leakage in a timely and accurate manner, this paper improves on the basis of YOLO v5 algorithm, and proposes a pipeline leak detection algorithm based on CBAM attention mechanism, which makes the model more focused on the extraction of pipeline leakage characteristics, weakens the influence of complex background on detection results, and combines Adaptively Spatial Feature Fusion to improve the scale invariance of features and reduce the computational overhead in the reasoning process. By experimenting on the leak dataset of self-built power plant pipelines, the CBAM-YOLO v5 algorithm improved the detection accuracy by 32.6%, the recall rate by 0.76%, and the mAP by 0.76% compared with the original YOLO v5 model 30.1%, the model performance improvement is obvious and conducive to field deployment.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method for Photovoltaic Panels Based on Improved ShuffleNet V2 and Infrared Images
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The long-term exposure of photovoltaic modules outdoors is prone to various faults that affect the safe and efficient operation of photovoltaic power plants. This paper studies a photovoltaic panel fault diagnosis method based on the improved ShuffleNetV2 network and infrared images of photovoltaic modules. First, the grayscale processing and data enhancement of the existing photovoltaic fault public data sets are used to obtain high-quality data sets. Then introduce the SENet attention mechanism in the lightweight network ShuffleNetV2 and improves the network unit structure, making it more suitable for the fault diagnosis task of photovoltaic modules. The experiment is compared with the MobileNetV2 and the original ShuffleNet V2 network. The improved method has a significantly improved fault diagnosis effect on the photovoltaic panel fault data set, and the overall accuracy rate reaches 84.06%, which has a certain practicability.

articleTitle: Secondary Frequency Modulation Control Strategy of Power System Using Energy Storage Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: By using the energy storage battery's characteristic of fast response, energy storage battery is introduced to participate in power grid frequency modulation in this paper. Firstly, the secondary frequency regulation simulation model of power grid with energy storage battery is established. Secondly, considering the frequency regulation requirements and the internal structure of the battery, the model which can effectively reflect the internal changes of the energy storage battery is proposed and all aspects of the model are analyzed. Then an equivalent simulation model of two-area interconnected system with energy storage battery is constructed. Finally, considering the demand of power grid frequency regulation and battery state of charge recovery, the battery condition decomposition-adaptive frequency regulation condition and SOC self-recovery condition are carried out. Through the logistic function transformation, the appropriate parameters are selected to formulate the corresponding maximum power of the energy storage battery under different output targets. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model and control strategy are verified by experiments with different load disturbances and different control variables.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Prediction Based on BP Neural Network Improved by t-Tent-SSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of new energy in the power system, the accurate prediction of wind power becomes more and more important to improve the economic benefits and stability of the power system. The traditional Sparrow search algorithm (SSA) optimized BP(SSA-BP) neural network for wind power prediction has the problems of easy to fall into local optimum, slow convergence rate and low prediction accuracy. This paper proposes a wind power prediction method based on sparrow search algorithm based on fusion of tent chaotic mapping and t distribution (t-Tent-SSA) and BP(t-Tent-SSA-BP) neural network. This paper takes a wind farm in northwest China as the research object, first introduces Perason's correlation coefficient, and analyzes the data with strong correlation with wind power output as the input of the model, so as to avoid redundant data affecting the accuracy of prediction and calculation speed. Secondly, SSA algorithm and t-Tent-SSA algorithm are used to optimize the BP neural network. Finally, the measured historical data of the wind farm are used to simulate the prediction models. The simulation results show that the prediction model based on t-Tent-SSA-BP has better prediction accuracy than SSA-BP, and is more in line with the requirements of power system operation. eezhouqiang@163.com

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control for DC-DC Converters with Unknown Constant Power Load in Renewable Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: DC microgrid technology has drawn extensive research attentions in recent years. It is regarded as a critical issue to obtain fast DC bus regulation and stability when feeding both different kinds of loads, including resistive loads and constant power loads (CPLs). A sliding mode control (SMC) design strategy is presented in this study for DC-DC converters with unknown CPLs. Firstly, disturbance observers are constructed to accurately reconstruct the multiple disturbances. By integrating disturbance compensations, the proposed composite controller is finally constructed for the converter system. Simulations are compared with existing integral sliding mode approaches to demonstrate the effectiveness of the presented controller. The presented approach is characterized by higher voltage tracking accuracy, better dynamic properties and stronger disturbance rejection ability in the presence of various working conditions.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimization of System Configuration of Green Hydrogen Projects
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electrolytic hydrogen produced through renewable energy can help to decarbonize some hard-to-abate sectors, including heavy industry and long-haul transport. However, the higher levelized cost of green hydrogen, compared to grey hydrogen produced from fossil fuels, has limited its large-scale deployment and application. However, an optimized system configuration of a green hydrogen project, including choosing a suitable power generation technology considering the renewable resources, and its capacity ratio to electrolysers, could help to yield the maximum hydrogen production at the lowest cost. In this paper, an optimization model embedded with the function of production simulation is presented. Then, five different component combinations for a green hydrogen project are introduced, including photovoltaic (short as PV)+electrolyser, wind power (short as WP) + electrolyser, WP+electrolyser+ storage, PV+electrolyser+storage and PV+WP+electrolyser+ storage. For each combination, the influences of generation technology to electrolyser ratio and annual capacity factor on the levelized cost of hydrogen (short as LCOH) and the operation characteristics of the system are analyzed. At last, suggestions concerning system configuration for deploying green hydrogen projects in different regions of China are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on Capacity Allocation of Grid Side Energy Storage Participating in Power System Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power system with high penetration of renewable energy resources like wind and photovoltaic units are confronted with difficulties of stable power supply and peak regulation ability. Grid side energy storage system is one of the promising methods to improve renewable energy consumption and alleviate the peak regulation pressure on power system, most importantly, provide reliable power supply when needed. This study firstly proposed a power and capacity configuration model of grid side energy storage system considering power stability and economic factors. Secondly, certain operation strategies of energy storage peak-shaving and valley-filling are investigated, including the one charging/discharging mode and the multiple charging/discharging mode for the full performance of energy storage system and ideal peak-shaving and valley-filling effect. Finally, case study based on real load curves and power unit structure of a certain area showed that grid side energy storage under peak-shaving and valley filling operation mode effectively improves the stability of power supply and reduce the peak regulation pressure. A one charging two discharging power and capacity allocation project are proposed to demonstrate the effect of peak-shaving and valley-filling.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Power Grid Fault Diagnosis and Auxiliary Decision-making System Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The ability of power system equipment fault diagnosis and auxiliary decision-making software directly affects the efficiency of decision-making and recovery in power grid faults events. This paper proposes a data-driven and knowledge-driven power grid fault diagnosis and auxiliary decision-making technology. Firstly, based on the fault diagnosis model realized by expert system, Bayesian network and artificial neural network, an artificial intelligence fault diagnosis fusion algorithm is established by using the information fusion strategy to improve the diagnosis accuracy of the existing single fault diagnosis model. Experimental results show that the accuracy of fault recognition of the fusion model is improved by about 20% compared with the existing expert system. Then, realized a fault handling auxiliary decision-making system based on the knowledge graph of emergency plan, which constructed by extracting the knowledge information of emergency plan. This system can effectively diagnose the failure of power system equipment, and give auxiliary decisions according to the relevant emergency plan map, which can effectively improve the recovery efficiency and capability of power system in fault events, and enhance the intelligent operation level of the power system.

articleTitle: Large-Signal Stability Analysis of MMC-HVDC System Under Grid Voltage Dips Based on Mixed Potential Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Modular multilevel converters (MMCs) are widely used in high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission systems due to their superior performance. However, when modular multilevel converter based high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) system become unstable under the large-signal disturbance of grid voltage dips, the small-signal analysis method would be no longer available. In this paper, the large-signal stability of MMC-HVDC system under grid voltage dips is studied based on mixed potential theory. First, a simplified state-space averaging model of MMC-HVDC system is established. Furthermore, the large-signal stability criterion is obtained by using the mixed potential theory and the system large-signal stability working area is delineated. Then, the influence of system parameters and the degree of grid voltage dips on the large-signal stability is studied. Finally, aiming at the unstable situation, a solution to adjust the system parameters and control parameters is proposed based on the large-signal stability criterion. Time-domain simulations conducted in Matlab/Simulink are used to verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the large-signal stability analysis method.

articleTitle: Short-circuit Current Calculation in Distribution Network with IIDGs Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In a distribution network with IIDG, the conventional short-circuit current calculation usually regards the IIDG simply as a constant current source or a voltage-controlled current source, which has problems with accuracy, calculation speed, convergence. In this paper, an artificial neural network based short-circuit current calculation is proposed. The output characteristic of IIDG during fault is analyzed, and a system simulation model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC. Typical features, such as the power transmitted over the line, the power of the load, and the voltage of bus are used to train the neural network model. In the IEEE33 bus system, the proposed method is validated and its performance is compared to the conventional short-circuit current calculation method.

articleTitle: Review on The Influence of New Energy Grid Connection on Power Quality of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of the "double carbon" strategy, the proportion of new energy power generation based on wind energy and solar energy is increasing. At the same time, it brings a series of power quality problems to the power grid. It is very important to study the causes of poor power quality caused by wind power and photovoltaic grid connection, and to formulate a scientific and reasonable comprehensive treatment plan for power quality. In this paper, the causes of grid harmonics, voltage fluctuation and flicker, voltage deviation, three-phase voltage imbalance and frequency deviation caused by the current wind power and photovoltaic grid connection are deeply studied. It is hoped to provide theoretical basis for the power system operators to take the optimal power quality prevention measures.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Power Flow by Interior Point Method for AC Distribution Network with Flexible Loop Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of the city and the implementation of the Rural revitalization strategy, a large amount of industrial electricity in the city has been transferred to the suburbs or towns, making the original load in the station area change. In order to solve this problem, the loop device of the flexible acacia converter, which can realize the bidirectional flow of energy, has attracted more and more scholars' attention. This paper firstly introduces the flexible loop closure control device for distribution network based on power electronic technology, and studies the optimal power flow of interior point method in distribution network with flexible loop closure converters. The algorithm verification is carried out, and the superior performance of the optimal power flow(OPF) of the path tracing interior point method is verified.

articleTitle: Capacity Optimization Configuration of Hybrid Energy Storage System Using a Modified Grey Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the randomness and intermittent characteristics of renewable energy power generation, a capacity optimization method of a hybrid energy storage system is proposed to ensure the economical and reliable operation of wind and solar power supply systems. The optimization method takes the minimum life cycle cost of the hybrid energy storage system as the optimization goal, takes the load power shortage rate and the energy storage capacity as the constraints, and establishes the optimal configuration model of the hybrid energy storage capacity. Based on this model, the modified gray wolf algorithm (MGWO) is used to solve the optimal capacity configuration of the hybrid energy storage system. Finally, the optimization results of MGWO are compared with the basic GWO and particle swarm algorithm (GWO) through a numerical example, and it is verified that MGWO can configure the hybrid energy storage capacity more reasonably.

articleTitle: Nonintrusive Load Disaggregation Combining with External Attention Mechanism and Seq2Piont
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Nonintrusive load disaggregation can deeply explore the value of customer power consumption data, providing a reference for decision analysis such as power equipment fault monitoring and demand response. Aiming at the conflict between training time and accuracy of nonintrusive load disaggregation, a novel nonintrusive load disaggregation algorithm combining an external attention mechanism with Seq2Point (Seq2Point-EA) model is proposed. Firstly, preprocess the original data by data purification, normalization, and some other operations, and build the training data with a same length window. Secondly, extract the appliance feature through the encoder layer. Thirdly, enhance the feature weights of important parts by introducing an external attention mechanism. Lastly, yield the results through the decoder layer. The proposed model was tested on the REDD dataset, and compared with the state-of-the-art model. The proposed model improves the disadvantage of distraction of the convolutional layer and enhances the extraction and utilization of effective information without increasing the training time cost.

articleTitle: A Robust and Intelligently Adaptive KPI Evaluation Method for Customer Call Center
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The customer call center is specialized in handling customer phone calls. Like other businesses, a key cornerstone for customer call center development is the ability to effectively and consistently evaluate call center performance, to determine areas for improvement and overall growth. Executives commonly establish key performance indicators (KPIs), which put a quantitative value on crucial business objectives, to evaluate the performance of an organization. After many years of practice and development, standard KPIs have been established for customer call centers. Those standard KPIs ideally will work. However, some issues are encountered in real applications. First, data sample sizes can be small, which will make KPI estimation very unstable and inaccurate. Second, customer call centers will cover a wide range of questions. As a result, some customer calls may be very challenging to handle, while some may be easy. Agents may be grouped and assigned based on different cell types, which imply different difficulties. It is unfair to ignore such task-specific effects when evaluating an agent. One strategy is to assign different weights to calls with different difficulties. Such weights are generally static or must be adjusted manually along time, which can be inefficient. To overcome these issues, we proposed an empirical Bayes hierarchical model. It can provide a robust estimate of KPIs even when the sample size is small. The call weights will be intelligently learned and automatically adjusted from data. Its superior performance was illustrated by an application to the real data generated from the customer call center at Guangxi Power Grid Corp.

articleTitle: Research on MPPT of the Photovoltaic System Based on the PSO-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Maximum power point tracking (MPPT) technique is an effective way to boost the utilization rate of solar energy in photovoltaic (PV) systems. Aiming at the problem of slow response and large fluctuations in MPPT for the PV system, this paper proposes an MPPT method with BP neural network based on the particle swarm optimization (PSO-BP), the PSO-BP neural network has strong nonlinear input and output capabilities, which can greatly improve the tracking of the photovoltaic maximum power point in terms of real-time control, stability and control accuracy. The PSO method is used to increase the convergence speed and lower the prediction error of the BP neural network by optimizing the starting weight and threshold, thereby improving the tracking speed and accuracy of MPPT. For the MPPT control of PV systems, a simulation model based on the PSO-BP neural network algorithm is developed. The PSO-optimized BP neural network has a quick convergence speed and smaller prediction error, according to the test and simulation findings. When compared to the BP neural network that has not been optimized, the PSO-BP neural network MPPT strategy can quickly and accurately track the maximum power point and significantly suppress power fluctuations under steady-state conditions, with good steady-state accuracy and dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Control Strategy for AC Fault Ride-Though at Receiving End of Offshore Wind Farm Integration based on VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For large-capacity offshore wind power based on VSC-HVDC, fault ride-through (FRT) is one of the most important problems to be solved. During the AC fault at the receiving end, the wind power system continues to provide wind power while the power transmission at the receiving end is blocked, which indicates that excessive active power would cause DC overvoltage risk. This paper first analyzed the topological structure and operating characteristics of a full bridge-dynamic braking system(FB-DBS). Combing the DBS, frequency increase method, and magnitude reduction method, a coordinated control strategy is proposed for offshore wind farms for fault ride-through(FRT). When the DC voltage exceeds the threshold value, FB-DBS is used to absorb the transient excessive active power of the DC links. Meanwhile, the wind turbine generator (WTG) would reduce the active power output by designed characteristics. By WTGs’ power reduction, FB-DBS rated capacity can be reduced effectively, which can achieve higher cost-efficiency, lower heat dissipation requirements and better FRT effects. Finally, a case study of a three-terminal VSC-HVDC for offshore wind power transmission is simulated in the PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Segmented Adaptive Control of Virtual Inertia for Virtual Synchronous Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the frequency dynamic response of microgrid, the inertia adaptive control strategy of the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is proposed. When the system frequency deviates from the nominal frequency, the VSG adopts large inertia to slow down the dynamic process. When the system frequency approaches the nominal frequency, the VSG uses a small inertial acceleration system to return to the rated state. However, most adaptive virtual inertial control strategies contain differential quantities causing the system to oscillate easily. In this paper, a segmented adaptive virtual inertia regulation method is proposed to avoid the effect of high-frequency noise, while considering the energy storage of the system and the frequency impact on the grid, which improves the safety and reliability of the virtual synchronous machine to the grid. Finally, the effectiveness of the control strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: An Optimal Control Strategy for LV Distribution Network with PV and Energy Storage Units
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing number and capacity of PV connected to the low voltage (LV) distribution network, the problems of node voltage fluctuations and network losses are becoming more and more serious. Taking the communication conditions and calculation capabilities of LV distribution networks into account, an optimization strategy for distributed PV and energy storage in low voltage distribution network was proposed, the purpose of which is to realize the suppression of voltage fluctuation and excessive network loss. First of all, the impacts of PV on node voltage and network loss were analyzed. Then, the optimal control model was established, whose objectives were maximizing the Source-charge storage matching, and whose constraint conditions were energy storage charge and discharge status, power and energy. In addition, the commercial tool CPLEX was chosen to solve the model. And finally, the effectiveness of the model was verified by a simulation example. The results show that the proposed model can reduce voltage fluctuations and network losses of the low voltage distribution network obviously.

articleTitle: Active-reactive Power Coordinated Optimization of Distribution Network with Photovoltaic Based on PSO-CSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The grid-connected of the energy storage system (ESS) makes the optimization of the distribution network not only limited to the unilateral reactive power optimization, but can be controlled and optimized by the active power-reactive power coordination with better effect. In this paper, the reactive power of distributed photovoltaic (DPV), the switching capacity of parallel capacitor banks, and the charging and discharging power of the ESS are used as control variables, the minimum network voltage deviation and active network loss are utilizes as the comprehensive optimization indicators to design the objective function. By adding the node voltage violation into the objective function in a form of penalty function, an active-reactive power coordination optimization model of the distribution network with DPV is established. The PSO-CSA algorithm is used to solve the optimization model, and the modified IEEE-33 node power distribution system is simulated to verify the feasibility of active-reactive power coordinated optimization.

articleTitle: Ultra-short-term Forecasting Method of Photovoltaic Power Generation Based on Combined Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the aggravation of the energy crisis and environmental pollution, the proportion of renewable energy generation is gradually increasing. Thus, accurate power forecasting is essential for safe access and reliable consumption of the power grid. The network structure of deep learning technology with multiple hidden layers makes it have excellent target data feature extraction ability for massive sample data and has particular applications in power prediction. In this paper, the feature of time series data of photovoltaic power generation is analyzed, and an ultra-short-term forecasting method of photovoltaic power generation based on a convolutional neural network and gated recurrent unit (CNN-GRU) is proposed. The influences of network model input factors, timestep value, and single-step and multi-step forecasting on forecasting results are analyzed. The simulation results of actual data show that the proposed model has good forecasting performance.

articleTitle: Fault arc Identification Method of PV System Based on Subband Energy after Wavelet Packet Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The series fault arc of photovoltaic power generation system is difficult to detect accurately using time-domain characteristics. The generation of fault arc is accompanied by the change of current energy. In this paper, wavelet packet decomposition is used to obtain the energy of each subband of series current. Based on the difference of energy distribution between normal and fault conditions, the threshold method is used to determine the generation of fault arc. This paper proposes two threshold selection principles and threshold determination methods, and calculates the detection accuracy of each subband for a single state under the two thresholds. Under the experimental system and sampling frequency in this paper, the subband energy E2 is the best distinguishing feature when using three-layer wavelet packet decomposition. This paper puts forward the process of arc determination, that is, when multiple continuous states are determined as arcs, the arc is determined to be generated. After analysis, the number of time windows and the determination time required for arc determination are given. For 25 groups of arcs tested, the process can achieve 100% accurate judgment. Finally, the advantages of the two threshold methods are summarized.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Hydrogen Energy Storage IES with Dual-fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Compared with the traditional integrated energy system (IES), the IES with hydrogen as the energy storage medium combines electrolytic hydrogen storage and fuel cell cogeneration, which can achieve large-scale consumption of renewable energy and obtain considerable carbon emission reduction benefits and economic benefits. In the scenario of regional power supply, solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) have attracted extensive attention due to their fuel flexibility and high reliability. However, as high-temperature fuel cells, their preheating process takes a long time, which reduces the flexibility of operation and scheduling. In contrast, proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) have low operating temperature and good start-stop capability, but poor fuel adaptability. According to the operation characteristics of the two fuel cells, this paper proposes a hydrogen energy storage IES architecture combined with SOFC and PEMFC to play the complementary advantages of the two fuel cells. Firstly, the mathematical model of each equipment is established. Then the day-ahead optimal scheduling model of the system is put forward with economy as the optimization objective. Finally, the advantages of the proposed dual-fuel cells hydrogen energy storage IES are verified based on simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Forecasting Method of Industry Electricity Consumption Considering Price Factor
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a forecasting method for industry electricity consumption considering price factor with time series analysis. In order to avoid the limitation that the conventional time series method is only used for short-term prediction, this paper analyzes the correlation between industry product price and electricity consumption, and studies the lag relationship between the two factors. Then the ARIMAX model with different parameters combinations of electricity consumption series and price change rate series was constructed, and the parameters of the prediction model were determined. The accuracy of the model was verified by actual data. This paper obtains the price and electricity consumption data of the steel industry. The ARIMAX model considering the price factor and the ARIMA model which is not considering the price factor are used to predict the electricity consumption of the steel industry. The prediction results show that the accuracy of load forecasting is significantly improved after considering the price factor. Based on this method, a industry load forecasting system is set up, and is used in steel, cement and aluminum industries. Good accuracy has been achieved in all applications.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of SVCs in Actual Power Grid Using Particle Swarm Optimization and Electromagnetic Transient Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As increasing load level and new technology emerges, penetration ratio of high voltage direct current transmission lines and renewable energy sources in power grid has been increasing. This brings new challenges to the reactive power control and voltage stability of the power system. Installing static var compensators is an effective solution to supply reactive power and improve voltage stability. The location and capacity of static var compensators have significant impacts to its performance. Correspondingly, the optimal configuration of location and capacity of static var compensators is an urgent problem to be studied. In this paper, a siting and sizing algorithm for the static var compensators based on electromagnetic transient simulation is derived, and the configuration of static var compensators is optimized using particle swarm optimization. Firstly, this paper designs a calculation method of the fault severity, and designs the optimization objective function which is based on and the fault severity and the total investment. Furthermore, this paper proposes the main process of the optimization algorithm, and introduces the generation method of the electromagnetic transient simulation model for the actual power grid. Finally, an actual AC-DC hybrid power grid with 1341 buses is studied to verify the proposed method and the results and the results demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively improve the voltage stability of AC-DC hybrid grids.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Frequency Stability Assessment of Power Systems Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the high penetration of renewable energy sources (RESs), the inertia levels of power systems decrease, causing the increasing risks of frequency instability. In this paper, a data-driven frequency stability assessment (FSA) method with scenario-based wind uncertainty modeling is proposed. First, a scenario-based procedure for wind uncertainty modeling is proposed. Moreover, the leading physical factors of FSA problems are analyzed and extracted as the basic input features. The input feature enhancement is established by solving rotor motion equations. Then, a physics-guided gated recurrent unit (PG-GRU) based FSA method is introduced. Finally, through case studies, the accuracy, rapidity, and applicability of the proposed FSA method under small data sets are validated in IEEE 10-machine 39-bus power system, and the advantages of adopting scenario-based wind power modeling are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research and Application of GIS Cable Terminal Acoustic-electric Combined Partial Discharge Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, an acoustic-electric combined detection method is proposed based on the acoustic and electrical signals of partial discharge. Firstly, based on the comparative analysis of ultra-high frequency and ultrasonic methods, a comprehensive detection scheme including ultra-high frequency sensor, ultrasonic sensor and high frequency current sensor is constructed, and the corresponding parameters of the sensor are set. Secondly, the acoustic-electric combined positioning method based on bisector method positioning and time difference positioning is proposed. Finally, through case analysis, the acoustic-electric combined detection method can quickly locate the discharge position, which verifies the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Strategy of Microgrid Based on TD3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is necessary to optimize the operation of micro power grid in order to improve its economy. Firstly, the mathematical model of optimal dispatching of microgrid is established. Taking the internal battery charge and discharge power, fan and photovoltaic output power of microgrid as the optimization vector and the minimum operation cost of microgrid as the optimization objective, based on the day ahead prediction data, the day is divided into 24h as a dispatching period for optimization. The Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic policy gradient algorithm (TD3) is used to solve the problem, and the power supply composition and cost data are obtained. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the algorithm and optimal scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Variable Turns Ratio CT Based on MOSFET Power Electronic AC Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is difficult to design the backward converter when energy harvesting current transformer (CT) works within a wide range of the primary voltage. It reduces the range of the secondary of CT by variable turns ratio technology within a wide range of the primary voltage. Thus, variable turns ratio technology enhances the practicability and flexibility of CT. After sampling and analyzing the secondary of CT, the secondary turns can be adjusted automatically by controlling the AC switches which are connected with the secondary winding. MOSFETs are used to construct the AC switch. It reduces the cost and control difficulty by optimizing the AC structure and drive circuit. The scheme can be applied to other types of transformers with automatic turns ratio.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Production Unit Capacity Optimization and Year-Round Operation Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With a soaring integration of renewable energy all over the world, power grid utilities and stakeholders are facing the balance of renewable energy consumption, fossil-fuel power plant retirement, and the power system dynamic stability support. Thereafter, a new theoretical concept is proposed as known as the Integrated Energy Production Unit (IEPU), which combines power-to-hydrogen (P2H) and carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) technology. Based on the theory of the IEPU, it can make full use of existed synchronous turbines to provide synthetic active and reactive ability for power system considering the large scale of renewable energy integration. In this paper, the concept of IEPU is verified using the open source software Framework for Integrated Energy System Assessment (FINE) with European load demand information. Then, the capacity optimization and simulation of IEPU operation for 8760 hours are carried out with the objective of minimizing the total annual cost. Multiple scenarios with different seasonal distributions of electric and heat loads are examined with the detailed value of power generation operation, energy conversion and storage.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Virtual Power Plants Considering Carbon Market
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As a priority industry in China to be included in the carbon trading system, the power industry has become the main body of carbon emission reduction. As a technology and market solution for aggregating distributed resources in the power grid, virtual power plants can further enhance the overall benefits of virtual power plants by aggregating electric vehicle resources to participate in the carbon market. This paper proposes an optimal scheduling method for virtual power plants to aggregate electric vehicles to participate in the carbon market. Electric vehicles are used as controllable loads and energy storage devices to participate in the optimal operation of virtual power plants, and to improve the economic benefits of virtual power plants participating in the electric energy market. The power plant participates in the certified emission reduction market by acting as an agent for electric vehicles, which improves the efficiency of electric vehicles participating in the carbon market. The analysis of an example shows that the advantages of traditional distributed resources and electric vehicles can be effectively complemented by the centralized optimal management of virtual power plants and simultaneous participation in electricity energy market and carbon market transactions, and the overall operation performance of virtual power plants can be improved.

articleTitle: Stability Test Analysis and Design of High-load Magnetic Bearing Assembly for The Rotor of Flywheel Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the core component of FESS(Flywheel Energy Storage System), the performance of magnetic levitation bearing directly affects the stability of high-speed rotor and the power consumption of the whole system. This paper aims at the engineering product development of 300KW/1.25KWh FESS. Combining with the decomposition of performance index of FESS, the design idea of flywheel rotor-ontology with metal wheel hub and composite wheel rim was put forward. Aiming at the demand of high reliability of magnetic bearing assembly for high speed rotor of high power of FESS, based on the comprehensive consideration of the relationship between the structure size, displacement and force, displacement and stiffness, current and force of the magnetic guide, the permanent magnet bias hybrid magnetic bearing assembly was designed. For the maximum bearing capacity of magnetic bearing assembly as the design goal, the driving control method that based on the 5-DOF(Degree of Freedom) of magnetic bearing of CDFC(Cross Decoupling Feedback Control) is studied and the power loss of magnetic bearing is effectively reduced. Finally, through the high-speed test and steady-state running-in test of the whole FESS, the stability characteristics of high-speed rotor under the condition of multiple speed change are analyzed and verified, which provides technical support for the practical application of flywheel energy storage system.

articleTitle: Health Status Evaluation of GIS Equipment Based on FAHP
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at improving the reliability of GIS (GAS insulated SWITCHGEAR) equipment and facilitating the preventive maintenance of GIS equipment, a GIS equipment health status evaluation method based on FAHP (Fuzzy analytic hierarchy process) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the 9-scale is one-to-one corresponding to the failure frequency or probability of FMEA(Failure mode and effects analysis) are taken into analysis. Secondly, the deterioration degree function is established by triangular fuzzy number. Finally, an example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness and usefulness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverter CCS-MPC Algorithm Based on DSOGI-PLL under Weak Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, a continuous control set model predictive control (CCS-MPC) algorithm is proposed for the stability control of photovoltaic grid-connected inverters in weak grids. Due to the problem that the impedance of the power grid cannot be ignored under the weak power grid, the stability of the power grid is reduced. Therefore, this paper will study the stability of three-phase grid-connected inverters in weak grids. In view of the problem that the phase-locked loop will be disturbed in the weak power grid, this paper use a phase-locked loop based on a biquad generalized integrator (DSOGI-PLL) to achieve precise phase-locking. MATLAB/Simulink is used to build the simulation model of three-phase grid-connected inverter, and analyze the output of three phase current after different impedance mutation. The difference is significantly smaller than the traditional PI control algorithm, which can improve the quality of the output voltage of the inverter and maintain the stability of the system.

Author Keywords: continuous control set model predictive control (CCS-MPC)

articleTitle: Grounding Fault Line Selection Method of Distribution Network Based on Time-Frequency Domain Energy Matrix
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the limitation of the method of line selection based on single fault characteristic in distribution network, this paper proposes a distribution ground fault line selection method based on time-frequency domain energy matrix. Firstly, the zero sequence current transient signal detected by the intelligent pole switch when the fault occurs is extracted, and the fault panoramic information matrix containing time frequency energy multi-dimensional features is constructed through LCD decomposition. Then the similarity of panoramic information matrix of adjacent detection points is calculated, and the reliable line selection of the fault line is realized according to the similarity. The simulation results show that this method comprehensively utilizes the time-frequency domain characteristic information of transient signals, and is less affected by high resistance fault conditions, distribution network structure and other factors. It can effectively improve the accuracy of distribution network fault line selection, has high adaptability and reliability, and has simple algorithm principle and fast calculation speed.

articleTitle: Performance Simulation and Dynamic Analysis of Marine Electric Propulsion System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electrically propelled ships have many advantages that are unmatched by diesel direct-driven ships and are therefore widely studied. The dynamic simulation of the ship's electric propulsion system was carried out and a mathematical model was developed. SIMULINK simulation module was used to simulate the dynamic performance of diesel generator sets under large loads. The simulation of the permanent magnet synchronous motor with SVPWM control was carried out with load starting and sudden load addition, and the dynamic change process of the internal parameters of the motor was analyzed in detail. In addition, a Ship-Engine-Propeller model was built to study the characteristics of propeller torque under direct starting and graded starting of electric propulsion ships, respectively. Finally, the overall simulation model of the ship electric propulsion system is built, and the starting process of the system is simulated under direct start and graded start respectively, and the simulation clearly and intuitively shows the dynamic process of the main parameters in the system.

articleTitle: Electricity Theft Detection based on Iterative Interpolation and Fusion Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electricity theft detection is important for discovering electricity theft users and reducing electricity loss. To address the problems that existing methods are inadequate for pre-processing electricity consumption data and capturing electricity consumption information of different periodic patterns, an electricity theft detection method based on iterative interpolation and fusion convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed in this paper. In the proposed method, a Bayesian ridge regression-based data interpolation method is used to predict and supplement the missing values in the electricity consumption dataset from existing data, and a fusion CNN architecture including two convolutional branches is proposed to capture the characteristics of data with different periodic patterns. The experimental results showed that the proposed method outperforms the comparison methods in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and other evaluation metrics, and can effectively recognize electricity theft users.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rotor Turn-to-turn Short Circuit for Doubly-fed Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Timely diagnosis of rotor turn-to-turn short-circuit faults in doubly-fed wind turbines can effectively reduce the overall risk of wind turbine operation and avoid major accidents. In this paper, the harmonic components of the stator current generated by the rotor turn-to-turn short circuit are analyzed based on the wavelet decomposition method, and an experimental model of the doubly-fed wind turbine fault is built in Matlab/Simulink, using the ratio of the number of shorted turns to the number of normal winding turns to reflect the degree of the motor fault. By wavelet decomposition of the stator-side currents, the fault characteristic quantities are extracted and the frequency bands containing the faults are analyzed spectrally. The results show that the fault characteristic frequency component generated by the stator current in the fault condition increases significantly with the degree of motor fault, and it has more heightened reliability and sensitivity to fault identification.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of Flow Rate on the Performance of Solar Water Heater Trickle System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Every country is faced with the problem of limited fossil fuels hence the need for renewable energy sources as alternative solutions to this problem. Among the numerous types of renewable energy, solar can produce 834.1 GW of energy, the highest in the world. It can be used as a heater by utilizing a solar collector, which is part of the Solar Water Heater (SWH). Therefore, this research aims to examine the performance of the SWH type trickle by determining the total efficiency with the fluid flow rate of 2, 3, and 4 lpm. The results showed that the total efficiency produced with 4 lpm higher than the 3 and 2 lpm, with an efficiency value of 58.3%, 49.9%, and 49.7%, respectively. The higher the flow rate, the lower the temperature, with a rise in the accumulated heat absorbed by the water hence the total efficiency value produced increases. In conclusion, the higher the total efficiency value, the better the SWH performance.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Ride-through Strategy and Fault Characteristics of Flexible Low Frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The Flexible Low Frequency Transmission System (FLFTS) has more complex coordination control mechanism and fault transient process. In this paper, the control architecture of the flexible low-frequency converter station is analyzed firstly. Based on the basic control principle of power electronic converter station, a fault ride-through strategy suitable for the FLFTS is proposed. When a fault occurs in the low-frequency line, the system detects a sudden drop in low-frequency voltage. After a short delay, the control pattern switching module of the converter station switches the low-frequency side control to the direct current control, and the low-frequency current re-tracks the preset current limiting target to achieve the goal of active current limiting fault ride-through. A two-terminal low-frequency transmission system model is built on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform to verify the effectiveness of the ride-through method. Finally, based on the simulation model, taking into account the fault ride-through control of the converter station, the impedance characteristics of the equivalent low-frequency variation of the FLFTS under different current limiting targets are analyzed, and the influence on the original protection is discussed.

articleTitle: A Multivariate Load Prediction Method of Integrated Energy Systems Based on MMoE-TCN
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to ensure the stable and economic operation of the integrated energy system, accurate multivariate load forecasting is undoubtedly a necessary prerequisite. However, all kinds of energy in IES have different physical characteristics and influence on each other. Considering the lack of multivariate load data, this paper proposes a GRU-GAN data generation and MMOE-TCN multi-task learning load prediction method. Firstly, the GRU-GAN data generation model is established to generate massive data in accordance with the temporal law according to the limited historical load data, so as to achieve the purpose of data enhancement. Then, the MMoE multi-task learning model based on parameter soft sharing mechanism was constructed, and the shared feature information was reasonably allocated through expert subnets and gating units, and the sub-task model was constructed using temporal convolution network. Finally, the IES open data set of Arizona State University Tempe campus is used for example analysis, and the errors are lower than those of the comparison model, which verifies the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Wind Power Data Cleaning Based on Autoencoder-Isolation Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The large amount of data collected from wind farms often contains abnormal data points, which makes it difficult to carry out work such us wind power prediction and wind power curve modeling. In this paper, an autoencoder-isolation forest is presented to solve the problems of complex and incomplete processing of traditional wind power data outlier removal methods. By segmenting the wind speed interval and combining the distribution characteristics of the anomalous data, the outliers are identified and eliminated using autoencoder-isolation forest, and then the cleaned data are reconstructed. Finally, the actual data set of the wind turbine is used for prediction and compared with the prediction results of the cleaned data to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Model of Voltage Quality Improvement Project in Medium and Low Voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Voltage is an important indicator of power quality. Voltage quality can not only effectively ensure the production sustainability and product quality of users, but also have an important impact on the safety and durability of electrical equipment. The construction project of distribution network adopts the way of determining the fund first and then the project. Therefore, there is an urgent need for a set of applicable models to evaluate the feasibility of investment and the rationality of investment income. By analyzing the causes of low voltage quality, combined with the progress of power grid construction and power grid planning projects, this paper puts forward the strategies to improve voltage quality by applying new technologies such as safety, maturity, economy, applicability and green environmental protection. In order to improve the voltage quality of medium and low voltage distribution network, the optimization model of voltage quality improvement projects of medium and low voltage distribution network is studied and formed. The model is used to rank the planning projects in a certain area, and the ranking results meet the proposed planning objectives. Then, the rationality and accuracy of the model are verified according to a number of implemented projects.

Author Keywords: medium and low voltage distribution network

articleTitle: A Novel Sliding Mode Control for Dual Three-phase PMSM System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The speed control problem of dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor has the characteristics of nonlinearity, parameter perturbation and load disturbance. To solve this problem, a new sliding mode approach law is proposed. The saturation function is used to replace the sign function to suppress chattering, and the approach law is used to design a sliding mode speed controller for dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor. According to the established mathematical model, the vector control model of the sliding mode speed controller based on the new approach law is established. Under three states of motor starting, steady state and sudden load, the new sliding mode approach law has less phase current impact , almost no buffeting, fast response of speed and torque, no overshoot of speed. The simulation results show that the speed controller can effectively improve the static and dynamic characteristics of the dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor drive system.

articleTitle: Research on the Device and Method for Improving the Accuracy of DC Resistance Measurement of Cable Conductor
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The traditional cable conductor DC resistance measurement test has the problems of large contact resistance and inaccurate conductor length measurement, which lead to inaccurate measurement of the cable conductor DC resistance. In order to solve this problem, this paper designs a four-terminal fixture device for the DC resistance of wire and cable conductors, and a method for measuring the DC resistance of cable conductors by using the device. By using the device and the method, on the one hand, the length of the cable conductor curve is measured through the length photoelectric sensing module and the length measuring fixture, thereby improving the measurement accuracy of the cable conductor length. On the other hand, using the current end clamp to apply a suitable crimping force reduces the contact resistance of the cable conductors. Finally, through the experimental verification, these two aspects can significantly improve the measurement accuracy of the DC resistance of the cable conductor, which verifies the effectiveness of the device.

articleTitle: Simulation of Typical Defect Characteristics of Partial Discharge of High Voltage Cable Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The difficulty of cable partial discharge detection is that the measurement method is affected by its structure, resulting in low detection efficiency and sensitivity. Moreover, it is difficult to determine which factors affect the strength of partial discharge signals through external sensors. In view of the above problems, this paper uses the finite element method (FEM) to carry out multi-physical field simulation of typical partial discharge defects. Through the simulation data analysis, the results show that the electric field is distorted at the defect position of the cable, and the local electric field strength exceeds the breakdown field strength at high voltage. At the same time, it is found that the resistance heat generated by the internal conductive particle defect is not obvious on the cable surface under the effect of solid heat transfer. The study lays the foundation for further exploring the characteristics of various signals when partial discharge breakdown occurs.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Planning Considering Renewable Investment and Coal-Fired Units Retirement
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the low-carbon transition of the power system, the gradual retirement of coal-fired power units is imperative. At the same time, renewables can be invested to make up for generation shortage caused by the retirement of coal-fired power units. However, with the increase of renewables penetration, it is necessary to improve the allocation of flexible resources in the system, such as energy storage. Here, we present a generation expansion model optimizing investment of renewables and energy in the process of retirement of coal-fired units. In order to better describe the physical characteristic of convention units, we use unit commitment (UC) to conduct operational simulations in the representative days. The proposed model is applied on RPS-38 system which is extracted from the real system of northwest China. The results show that energy storage can better support the increase of renewables penetration under the retirement of coal-fired power units.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Control Strategy of Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on Wavelet Package Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Energy storage system may play an important role in increasing generation scheduled ability and providing the ancillary services to the power system with high proportion of variable renewable energy resources. Aiming to smooth the fluctuations of the photovoltaic power using the energy storage system, this paper at first analyzes the characteristics of the photovoltaic output power fluctuations, and then by considering the advantages of the energy-type and power-type storage systems, a coordinated control strategy for the hybrid energy storage system which is composed of the battery and the flywheel energy storage systems, is proposed based on wavelet packet transform. The wavelet packet transform decomposes the photovoltaic output power fluctuations into the high and low-frequency parts. The flywheel energy storage system is used to smooth the high-frequency fluctuations of photovoltaic output power, while the battery energy storage system is used to smooth the low-frequency fluctuations of photovoltaic output power. Simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can reasonably allocate the fluctuating power to power-type and energy-type energy storage systems and efficiently smooth the fluctuations of photovoltaic power.

articleTitle: Call Option based Risk Management for Wind Power Producers in Day-ahead Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Wind power producers’ (WPPs’) bid deviations in the day-ahead wholesale market can be compensated through the balancing market. Due to the uncertainties of wind power output and balancing market prices, WPPs will face great risk when bidding in the day-ahead market. For this reason, a method is proposed for a WPP to mitigate the balancing market price risk through call option contract. To study the impact of the WPP’s option contract on its day-ahead market bidding behavior, a stochastic equilibrium model of the day-ahead market is developed considering the WPP’s call option contract, in which scenario reduction techniques are used to handle wind speed and balancing market price uncertainties. Numerical examples are presented to verify the validity of the model. It is shown that the call option contract is helpful to reduce the WPP’s bid deviations and its revenue volatility in the day-ahead market. In addition, the WPP can maximize its utility through an appropriate option contract volume.

articleTitle: A Model for Inverter Loss Considering Output Current Ripple
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, an inverter loss model is proposed, and the two-level topology is taken as an example to analyze and illustrate this model. Considering the high frequency ripple of the inverter output current at switching times, when the output current crosses zero, the power device is in the soft switching state. Two power devices on a bridge arm successively appear in the soft switching-on state, which does not exist in the traditional average current loss analysis. This paper focuses on the analysis of the switching loss in this state to improve the accuracy of the loss model. The converting process of the one-phase bridge arm is analyzed in this paper, and then the loss of each stage of the power device is modeled based on it. The loss calculation method proposed in this paper is verified by the grid-connected experiment of a SiC-380V /50kVar inverter. The experimental results show that the loss model proposed in this paper improves the accuracy of the traditional model. The loss model presented in this paper can also be extended to other high frequency power electronic inverter topologies, such as type I three-level and type T three-level.

articleTitle: A Robust Square Root Unscented Kalman Filter For Power System Dynamic State Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The unscented Kalman filter (UKF) has been widely used in power system dynamic state estimation (DSE), which provides a guarantee for the establishment of a high-quality database to store power network information. However, traditional UKF faces two main problems. First, the performance of traditional UKF will deteriorate due to the interference of non-Gaussian noise. Second, the traditional UKF estimator will be interrupted owing to the Cholesky decomposition of asymmetric positive definite matrix. To deal with these problems, this paper develops a square root UKF based on minimum error entropy with fiducial points (MEEF) criterion (SR-MEEF-UKF). The MEEF criterion inherits the common advantages of correntropy and error entropy, exhibiting robustness to outliers. At the same time, the kernel matrix in SR-MEEF-UKF is non-singular. Through performing DSE in the IEEE-14 bus system, the proposed SR-MEEF-UKF not only has excellent performance in non-Gaussian noise environments, but also has strong numerical stability.

Author Keywords: minimum error entropy with fiducial points

articleTitle: Steam Reforming of a Diesel Surrogate to Produce Hydrogen-Rich Syngas for Solid Oxide Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Storage and transportation of hydrogen is a great challenge that restricts the applications of fuel cells. It is an effective solution to produce hydrogen onsite by using steam reforming of hydrocarbon fuels to avoid storing and transporting hydrogen directly. The steam reforming of diesel attracts a lot attentions recently because diesel is a widely used logistic fuel in heavy duty trucks and vessels. However, the diesel reforming is usually based on expensive noble metal catalysts which limits its commercialization. Moreover, the comprehensive influences of operating conditions on the reforming performances have not been thoroughly explained. The present work is devoted to experimentally investigate the steam reforming of n-hexadecane as a diesel surrogate over an in-house made non-noble metal Ni based catalyst. The co-impregnation method is used to washcoat the catalyst on a cordierite honeycomb monolith. Experiments are conducted to study the influences of steam to carbon ratio (S/C), weight hourly space velocity (WHSV) and reformer operating temperature (T) on the n-hexadecane conversion rate, mole fractions of gas species produced and the production flow rate of each species. An 8 h continuous operation confirms that the catalyst activity is table, yet the fuel conversion rate decreases with operating time because coke formation blocks the catalyst active sites.

articleTitle: Analysis and Selection of Working Fluid for Marine Ejection-Compression Air-Conditioning System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presents a modified dual-loop bi-evaporator ejection-compression cycle driven by marine waste heat dealing with the varying sensible and latent loads in different climates. Based on the constant-pressure mixing theory, a thermodynamic model is developed to investigate the effects of various parameters such as the generator, two evaporators and the condenser temperatures on the ejector behaviour and cycle performance. Eco-friendly refrigerants, such as R134a, R245fa, R600, R290, R1234yf, R1234ze(E), and R1233zd (E), are adopted as the working fluid. To assess the modified cycle performance, a new conception of global COP is introduced, where heat consumption and electric power are converted to the same grade before added together. The model results show good agreement with the corresponding experimental data, where the average deviation is 3.34%, and the deviation ranges from -9.93% to 7.46% for the ejector entrainment ratio. The results indicate that the highest global COP utilizing R1233zd(E) followed by that of R245fa, with the R1234yf system having the lowest value. Meanwhile, the condenser temperature of the hybrid refrigeration cycle has a great influence on the performance of the cycle. This paper is expected to provide a good reference for the utilizing prospect of R1233zd(E) and R245fa in ejector-compression refrigeration systems.

articleTitle: A Review of Motor Drive Thermal Management System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The motor drive system of an electric vehicle converts the electric energy in the battery into mechanical energy, to provide driving power for the car, which is an important part of an electric vehicle. This paper first introduces the heat source and temperature rise hazards of the motor drive system and analyzes the limiting factors of electric vehicle performance improvement. Then the existing motor cooling technologies are summarized, and their principles, advantages, and disadvantages are analyzed. Finally, the principles and effects of air cooling, liquid cooling, and air-liquid combined cooling are introduced in detail based on specific cases and simulation results. The development trend of the motor cooling system is clarified, which can provide some reference for the improvement of the electric vehicle motor cooling system.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Microgrid Integration Based on Combination Weighting
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Microgrid is an important part of the energy Internet, and its grid-connected operation can not only solve the problem of new energy grid connection, but also improve the reliability of the main grid. However, the energy bidirectional flow generated by the grid connection of microgrids brings certain risks to the stable operation of the main grid. In order to assess the risk of microgrid grid connection more comprehensively and objectively, a risk assessment index system has been established from four aspects: power grid stability, power quality, economic and environmental protection, management and information. Using the subjective and objective weights of the composite empowerment fusion indicators, a risk assessment model is established, and the risk assessment results are obtained by the TOPSIS method. Through case analysis, it is verified that the proposed model can effectively assess the risk impact of microgrid grid connection on the main grid.

articleTitle: Customer-Side Load Forecasting Method Based on Two-Level Clustering and MGRU-AT
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, the potential analysis of adjustable load resources is mostly based on refined model to describe its demand and regulation ability, and less consider the load data drive and the correlation within the data. Accurate and effective classification of different types of adjustable load resources by historical load data, and then considering the characteristics of adjustable load, accurate prediction can effectively improve the accuracy of load potential calculation. An adjustable load power prediction method ( CK-MGRU-AT ) based on improved Canopy and K-Medoids two-level clustering, multi-channel gate recurrent unit ( MGRU ) and attention mechanism ( AT ) are proposed in this paper. Firstly, the improved Canopy algorithm is used to obtain the cluster center samples of various types of adjustable resources. Then the load data with similar characteristics are aggregated into a cluster by K-Medoids algorithm, which makes GRU more conducive to extracting the time characteristics of load data. Finally, the MGRU-AT model is used to extract the time characteristics of each cluster, and it is finally mapped to the power prediction outputs of different types of adjustable loads through the full connection layer. In order to verify the advantages of the proposed model ( CK-MGRU-AT ) in the stability of prediction accuracy, this paper uses the historical load data of industrial and commercial users in a typical region for experimental analysis. The results show that the proposed model reduces the average absolute error at least 0.0003, the mean square error 0.0149, and increases the R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> index at least 0.0027.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Integrated HVDC Power System Modeling for Transient Frequency Stability Online Assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Integrating large-scale renewable energy into the power system leads to a deepening nonlinearity power system. As a result, power grid frequency faces a more severe problem of online transient stability evaluation. Online simulation and evaluation analysis technology have proved to be a valuable tool for analyzing and studying the transient frequency stability of the power system under renewable energy integration. Aiming to solve these aforementioned problems, this paper proposes a multi-index evaluation method, which provides frequency transient safety and stability margin assessment based on detailed model simulations. This evaluation method has high model accuracy and an intuitive simulation analysis process, which can reflect the steady change trend of system frequency. Critical failure simulation verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method with online power grid information.

Author Keywords: frequency safety and stability margin index

articleTitle: Inspection and Classification System of Photovoltaic Module Defects Based on UAV and Thermal Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the vigorous development of large-scale photovoltaic power plants, the demand and requirements for defect inspection of photovoltaic power plant modules are also increasing. At present, manual inspection is inefficient, costly and insecure. The inspection method combined with UAV and thermal imaging technology has high efficiency, low cost and less safety risk, which is an effective means to realize unmanned operation and maintenance of photovoltaic power plants. Combined with the image recognition technology of artificial intelligence, this paper designed an inspection and classification system based on UAV. Firstly, this paper summarized the corresponding relationship between the thermal image characteristics and the common defects of photovoltaic modules, and established a knowledge base of photovoltaic module defects based on image features. Then, an automatic image recognition algorithm model of photovoltaic modules based on YOLOV5 is built. Finally, based on the UAV and thermal camera, an inspection and classification system is built for testing and verification. The system collects thermal images of photovoltaic modules by UAV, and then distinguishes thermal anomalies of different shapes by AI automatic identification technology. The defects such as shelter, smudge, bypass diode damage, open circuit and short circuit are identified, and the treatment measures are given. On the basis of ensuring the recognition accuracy, the system greatly improves the efficiency of photovoltaic module detection, and has been successfully applied in a photovoltaic power plant.

articleTitle: Intelligent Commutation Strategy Based on Improved Discrete Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The three-phase unbalance in the low-voltage distribution station area is getting serious, which has brought many adverse effects to the stable operation of the power grid. Commutation switch is the fundamental way to solve this problem. According to the actual wiring situation of commutation switch, an intelligent commutation switch strategy based on improved discrete particle swarm optimization (IDPSO) is proposed. The strategy takes the current unbalance and the number of commutation switches as a multi-objective function, which can quickly solve the optimal commutation switch combination. Finally, the effectiveness of the control strategy is verified by Matlab / Simulink experiment. The experimental results show that the improved discrete particle swarm optimization intelligent commutation switch commutation strategy with faster convergence speed and more significant effect, and can effectively improve the three-phase unbalance in the distribution area.

articleTitle: Research on Capacity Optimization of Power Station for Electric Taxi Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to some characteristics of power energy, electric vehicles cannot achieve instantaneous energy supplements at present. Although the rapid charging technology takes a short time, it still cannot fundamentally solve the contradiction between ‘endurance mileage’ and ‘battery capacity’. At present, China State Grid and Southern Power Grid Corporation put forward the operation mode of electric vehicle charging and switching power stations. Taxi is an important part of urban public transport.
