In the construction and operation of electric taxi switching power stations, although a certain number of switching power stations are put into use, the research on the optimal capacity optimization planning of electric taxi switching power stations is still scarce, and thus the rational allocation of resources cannot be achieved in the construction and operation of distribution network switching power station. In order to solve this problem, this paper studies the capacity optimization of electric taxi switching stations by constructing a comprehensive cost model of switching stations. The main approach is to study the optimal battery capacity of the swapping station under the condition of different scales of service for electricity swapping and leasing, taking the maximum return of the swapping station as the optimization objective, taking into account the fixed investment cost and battery purchase cost in the construction and operation of the swapping station, and taking the price as the constraint condition.

articleTitle: A Method for Optimal Allocation of Source-load-side Flexible Resources Considering the Demand of Peaking Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Optimizing the allocation of source-load-side flexible resources is necessary to improve the operational flexibility of the power system with a high percentage of renewable energy. So we propose a method to optimize the allocation of source-load-side flexible resources considering the demand of peaking scenarios. The load and new energy output forecast values are based on the ARIMA model, and the peak regulation capacity demand is derived under the period. The optimal allocation model of source-load-side flexible resources is established to minimize the total operating and investment costs. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the model to obtain the optimal allocation scheme. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by using a regional grid case in Suzhou.

articleTitle: Thermal Performance Analysis of Dual-Axis Tracking Photovoltaic/Thermal Cogeneration System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, the thermal performance of the dual-axis tracking photovoltaic/thermal (PV/T) cogeneration system is studied. Firstly, the performance of the low-concentrating PV/T system with different tracking modes is explored. The energy output characteristics of the single-axis tracking system and the dual-axis tracking system in different axes are compared. Under the four typical weather conditions, the average electrical energy of the dual-axis tracking system is 35%, 28%, 31%, and 36.6% higher than that of the east-west single-axis tracking system, respectively. It can be seen that the performance of the dual-axis tracking system is superior to that of the single-axis tracking system. Secondly, a dual-axis tracking PV/T cogeneration system model under all operating conditions is constructed. The simulation data illustrates that the low-concentrating PV/T system can provide 4 times the amount of thermal energy while electrical energy. As a final remark, the low-concentrating dual-axis tracking PV/T system has good cogeneration performance.

articleTitle: A Review: Preparation of Biodiesel and Its Influence on the Performance of Marine Diesel Engines
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With increasing demand for fossil fuels and environmental awareness around the world, as well as tougher emissions regulations, renewable and environmentally friendly biodiesel is seen as an ideal alternative fuel. In this review, the preparation process, advantages and sources of the first, second generation biodiesel, as well as their effects on the combustion characteristics, and emission characteristics of Marine diesel engines are studied. The study found that the physical of biodiesel and petrochemical diesel are similar, but the chemical composition is different. Using biodiesel has a good prospect, which can meet the fuel demand of Marine diesel engine and reduce the emission content.

articleTitle: Brief Analysis of Compound Air Conditioning System in a Battery Manufacturing Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, A compound air conditioning system energy saving scheme for the lithium battery industry is proposed. The composite air-conditioning system combines free cooling system, water-water heat pump simultaneous cooling and heating technology, frequency conversion technology and variable flow technology. Taking the project of a lithium battery manufacturing plant in Jiangsu as an example, this paper compares the operation results of the compound air-conditioning system and the factory's original distributed air-cooled screw refrigeration system + direct-fired dual-effect lithium bromide system. The results show that the composite air-conditioning system has achieved an annual energy saving of 51%, reduced energy costs by 4.62 million yuan, and reduced carbon dioxide emissions by 1,200 tons. The successful application of the project provides an attractive solution for the energy efficiency improvement of similar projects and the design of high-efficiency power station buildings for new projects.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Evaluation Theory Based Peak Regulation Strategy for Guangxi Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The development of new energy highlights the problem of system peak regulation. During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, the key measure for relieving peak regulation pressure and improving the economy of power system operation is to maximize the potential of power peak regulation through optimizing strategy. The optimization model for peak regulation considering multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation is constructed by utilizing tomography analysis theory and single-objective optimization theory, then the solving method for the optimization model was designed. According to the current situation of Guangxi power grid, the proposed model is applied to study the peak regulation strategy of Guangxi, which concluded that during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, thermal power flexibility transformation and self-contained power plant should be promoted. This paper provides a reference for improving the peak regulation ability of Guangxi power grid, and contribute to the construction of a peak regulation market platform in the future.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Compensation Device Based on Magnetic-valve Controllable Reactor in the Treatment of Low Voltage at the End of Line
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper introduces the basic principle of magnetic-valve controllable reactor and the realization method of reactive power compensation system. At the same time, the low voltage at the end of 10kV line A is introduced. The operating conditions at a certain time are restored. And the problem of low voltage at the end of 10kV line A is analyzed. The ability of magnetic-valve controllable reactor reactive power compensation device to resist sudden reactive power deficiency is verified by adding magnetic-valve controllable reactor reactive power compensation device to line simulation. Finally, it is demonstrated that the reactive power compensation device based on magnetic-valve controllable reactor can improve the voltage to a certain extent when the short circuit fault occurs on the line.

articleTitle: A Distribution Network Automation Terminal Configuration Method Considering Power Failure Loss and Power Supply Reliability
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The main purpose of assembling automation terminals in the distribution network is to reduce the power outage time caused by permanent faults, reduce power outage losses and improve power supply reliability. Most of the traditional optimal configuration methods of distribution network automation terminals only aim to minimize power outage losses. However, in practical engineering applications, planners often want to minimize power outage losses and maximize power supply reliability. Therefore, this paper proposes an automatic terminal configuration method for the distribution network based on the epsilon constraint algorithm, which considers the power failure loss and power supply reliability. Calculation example analysis shows that this method can more intuitively understand the complex relationship between power outage loss and power supply reliability under different life cycle cost (LCC) constraints, which facilitates the smooth progress of optimal configuration work.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Proportion-Integral Controller Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning for DC-DC Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The control effect of boost converter with fixed parameters PI controller is not ideal when facing large and frequent load changes. A self-tuning PI control strategy based on the Double DQN algorithm is proposed to improve the performance. Dynamic optimization function of deep reinforcement learning is applied to adjust the parameters of PI controller. This strategy generates self-tuning PI-KP/PI-KI controller based on the Double DQN algorithm. Simulation results show that the output voltage of the boost converter is stable when the external environment interferes or the input voltage or load fluctuates. Compared with traditional PI control, this strategy can adjust parameters in real time, and both steady-state performance and dynamic performance are improved.

articleTitle: Feasible Analysis of Pulsating Heat Pipe Applied to Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC), as a new power generation method with high efficiency, cleanness and no pollution, has broad development prospects, but it’s thermal management problems need to be solved urgently. This paper uses ANSYS Fluent software, based on the VOF model and PHMPC model, uses the unsteady state method to simulate PEMFC without pulsating heat pipe and PEMFC with pulsating heat pipe, respectively, to study the temperature distribution law inside PEMPC. The results show that the temperature at PEMFC channel is the highest, about 68°C. Compared with PEMPC without pulsating heat pipe, it is found that the temperature of PEMPC channel decreases by about 12°C. Therefore, the pulsating heat pipe can reduce the internal working temperature of PEMFC. The simulation results can provide a theoretical basis for future experiments.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization of Series Solar-assisted Ground-source Hybrid Heat Pump Focusing on Heating
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To study the increase of energy consumption and soil heat imbalance caused by the performance degradation of solar-assisted ground source heat pumps under long-term heating operation, the TRNSYS simulation platform was used to analyze the solar-assisted ground-source heat pump in series (SGSHPs) systems and ground-source heat pump (GSHP) systems in Shanghai and Lanzhou. Heating performance and total operating energy consumption are investigated. Then, the impact of 20-year long-term operation of the two systems on the changes in the ground temperature environment has been analyzed. The results show that the total energy consumption of the SGSHPs system is 30% lower than that of the GSHP system when the radiation area is 120 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the hole depth is 100 m. Compared with the GSHP system, the coefficient of performance of heat pumps (COPHP) of the SGSHPs system has increased by 4.58% during the 20-year operation, and the ground temperature has been reduced by 21.83%. The hybrid system is more energy-efficient and environmentally friendly.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Flexible Ramp Capacity of Power Systems with Battery Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power in recent years, its fluctuation and uncertainty pose a greater challenge to the power system. More ramping capacities are needed to cope with the wind ramp events. Due to its fast charging and discharging and bi-direction power flow, energy storage has good ramp performance that can be used to provide flexible ramp capacity to improve the flexibility of operation. Recent studies on ramp capacity mainly focus on real-time scheduling but neglect the multi-scale nature of wind ramp events. In order to meet real-time scheduling, it is necessary to prepare sufficient reserves in advance. Based on this, this paper embeds flexible ramp capacity into day-ahead scheduling. The energy storage considering its flexible ramp capacity is modeled. The control strategy in different time scales is discussed. The state of charge (SOC) management is taken into account. An optimal unit commitment model considering the flexible ramp capacity of energy storage is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified on IEEE RTS 24 bus system using Python 3.6.

articleTitle: Identification of Transient Voltage Stability Weakness in Power Systems Based on Grad-CAM
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the changes in generation and load characteristics, transient voltage problems have a serious impact on the safe and stable operation of the power system. In this paper, on the basis of constructing a fast evaluation model of transient voltage stability based on convolutional neural network, the key electrical quantities that the model focuses on in the evaluation process are pointed out by Grad-CAM algorithm, and the weakness of system voltage stability are identified. The simulation results show that the proposed method can explore the links that are neglected by traditional methods, and the identified weakness consider both topological and state information, which verifies the superiority of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Sensorless Equalization Current Estimation of Liquid Metal Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Liquid metal batteries (LMBs) are promising for a wide range of applications. However, due to the low voltage of individual batteries, they need to be connected in series for use in large groups. Thus, balancing of the battery pack is required. The effect of the equalizing current is often ignored when using SoC as the equalization criterion in traditional study, but the high equalizing current for LMBs is not negligible. However, the acquisition of the equalizing current is costly and difficult to implement. To solve this problem, this paper investigates a sensorless equalizing current estimation method for LMB equalization circuits. By building a simulation model of the battery and the equalization circuit, analyzing the equalization circuit characteristics and using the simulation findings to fit the parameters, an equation for the estimation of the equalization current is given. The results show that the average error of the equalizing current estimation is less than 3%.

articleTitle: Research on Sub/Super-synchronous Oscillation Interaction of Multiple D-PMSGs-gridding System Based on Transfer Function Method
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The interactions in multiple D-PMSGs-gridding systems are quite complex, and it is difficult to determine the oscillation paths and dominant oscillation sources. To solve this problem, the transfer function method of multiple input and multiple output is adopted, and the interactions in multiple D-PMSGs-gridding systems are analyzed. First, a system example of 4 D-PMSGs and 5 nodes is established, and the transfer matrix model is obtained. Secondly, the interaction between D-PMSGs and grid and the interaction between different D-PMSGs is analyzed. Then, the oscillation path and oscillation source are determined. Finally, targeted optimization measures are proposed, which are optimization of cutting D-PMSG and optimization of parameters, and it is verified by using eigenvalue method and time-domain simulation method.

articleTitle: Application of PSDF Technology in Smart Building Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Relying on the project Application and Demonstration of Smart Building Energy System Based on DC Microgrid Technology-of Shanghai Science and Technology Commission, the research about planning, application, maintenance and control of energy system on smart building were carried out. With the integration of multiple technologies which include solar photovoltaic, energy storage, low-voltage DC power and flexible electricity, a demonstration project based on PSDF (Photovoltaic, Storage, DC, Flexible) technology was built. The demonstration project constructed an energy system application scenario of multi-energy complementary and collaborative optimization, which achieved remarkable energysaving effect and can be replicated nationwide.

articleTitle: Topology Identification in Distribution Network Using Second-Order Cone Programming of Power Flow Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Fast and accurate topology identification is particularly important to achieve the observability, measurability and controllability of distribution network. A topology identification method using second-order cone programming of power flow estimation is proposed in this paper. Using a small number of line power measurements and a large number of load pseudo-measurements, the power flow estimation of the distribution network with unknown topology is completed by constructing a second-order cone programming problem. According to the power flow estimation results, the possible topologies are screened and their difference indices is compared to complete topology identification. The effectiveness of the proposed topology identification method is examined on the IEEE 33-bus test case.

articleTitle: Accurate Estimation of Time-of-Arrival of Partial Discharge Pulses Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition and Energy Criterion Method
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The accurate detection of time-of-arrival (TOA) of partial discharge (PD) pulses is significant for partial discharge location and identification, with more and more related research and applications. This paper proposes a three-step TOA detection method of PD pulses: first, Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) is used for denoising, then trigger level method is used for preliminary detection and data segmentation, and finally Energy Criterion (EC) method is used for accurate detection. Simulation based on generated data and experiments based on XLPE cable are carried out to verify the effectiveness of this method. For simulating data under different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), five detection method are compared, and this method has the best performance in most cases, with the average relative error being only 2.6655% for data with SNR from-20 to 0.

articleTitle: Research on Pinch Analysis and Energy Saving of Union Stations A
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Pinch analysis is a mature and well-established process energy analysis method, which can achieve significant energy saving effect in industrial production. This paper firstly analyzes the heat exchange network of the crude oil gathering and transportation system of of the Union Station A by using the pinch technology, and uses the problem table algorithm (PTA) to determine the pinch temperature and establish the heat exchange network. After adding 5 heat exchangers to optimize the heat exchange network, the maximum energy saving potential is 5797.2kW, and the energy saving effect can reach 42.2%. The energy saving effect is remarkable after the implementation of energy saving transformation.

articleTitle: Fault Identification Based on Von Mises-Fisher Distribution in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a fault identification method based on von Mises-Fisher(vMF) distribution, which uses DFT method to calculate the voltage fault phasor in the fault process and form the real-time estimated fault phasor sets. Firstly, the eigenvector set under various typical faults is computed for vMF modeling and introduces a mixture of VMF model (movMF). Acording to the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, the parameters of the movMF model are statistically calculated: mean direction and concentration parameters. The fault identification results are obtained by comparing the mean direction and real-time estimated phasor of the vMF model corresponding to each fault. Finally, simulation results show that the proposed method can give reliable identification results under different conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Frequency Conversion Transformation of 660MW Unit Electric Feed Pump
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In a 660MW supercritical direct air cooling unit, the feed pump is transformed from hydraulic coupling speed regulation to frequency conversion speed regulation. The application of frequency conversion technology can effectively solve the large loss caused by pump regulation and make the feed pump operate in an economic state. Through the operation of feed pump after frequency conversion transformation, the economy and energy-saving effect of feed pump transformation are analyzed, Reduce power generation costs and auxiliary power consumption rate, effectively save energy and reduce consumption, and improve the economic benefits of thermal power plants. The transformation project is to accelerate the pace of industrial upgrading of power industry and achieve the goal of energy conservation and emission reduction of power plants.

articleTitle: CWT Analysis of Transient Stability Voltage in Power System EMT Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Considering the trend of large-scale renewable energy integration, the supporting and regulating capacity of the power system continuously decrease under the effect of energy replacement. As a result, the power grid begins to confront the challenge of transient voltage stability assessment. This paper proposes a transient voltage fluctuation analysis method based on the time-frequency domain continuous wavelet analysis(CWT), aiming to solve the voltage instability problem under renewable integration. Therefore, the proposed method intuitively connects the abstract process of voltage transient stability change with the physical change process of the power grid. Moreover, the transient voltage post-fault state changes can be emphasized by analyzing the turning-point of voltage stability in the time-frequency domain. The electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation analysis is an effective tool for analyzing and studying the transient voltage stability assessment under utility-scale renewable energy integration. Therefore, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified using the EMT simulation software-based industrial power system model.

articleTitle: Electrothermal Simulation Analysis on Power Loss and Junction Temperature of GaN HEMT in Boost DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power loss calculation and junction temperature analysis are of great significance to the thermal design in power electronics. In this paper, an electrothermal simulation analysis on GaN HEMT is performed based on the power loss calculation under actual working conditions including conduction loss and switching loss. By coupling the power loss and heat conduction process, the temperature distribution of the GaN HEMT, as well as the junction temperature, can be obtained by both the FEM thermal simulations and RC thermal model. The results show that the switching loss accounts for about 20% of the total power loss, far less than the conduction loss of 80% under the given working conditions. The RC thermal model based on the thermal resistances obtained by FEM simulations can predict the results of FEM simulations well for cases with different heat source distributions, while the model with original thermal resistances from thermal conductivity and size of layers cannot provide accurate predictions. The maximum junction temperature occurs in the case of concentrated distributed heat sources. This research is promising to provide valuable references for thermal management in GaN electronics.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Coupled Power and Transportation System Based on Double-Objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a double objective optimization method, integrating user equilibrium and system optimal solution in traffic assignment problem, to guide the operation of power distribution system with charging stations. This paper also investigates the change of weight between individual travel cost and cost of the whole system, and its impact on power system operation. The result shows that the user equilibrium is better to reduce the cost of generation, but leads to higher power loss. Since the interaction between power and transportation system is investigated in detail, this paper may give advice to system operators to predict generation plan according to traffic information, or adjust vehicle guidance strategy to satisfy specific requirement of PDN.

articleTitle: PID Parameter Tuning of Combined Heat and Power Generation Unit Based on Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the problem that the operation mode of “determining electricity by heat” of cogeneration units makes it difficult for the unit load change rate to meet the requirements of automatic generation control (AGC) instructions of the power grid, the unit operation parameters fluctuate too much, and the traditional PID parameter setting efficiency is low, this paper takes 300MW cogeneration units as an example, takes the integral of time multiplied by the absolute value of error as the optimization objective function, and uses differential evolution algorithm to set the PID parameters. Through simulation, it is found that the differential evolution algorithm can improve the unit load change rate and maintain a relatively stable main steam pressure and heat source supply. Finally, the effectiveness of the differential evolution algorithm is verified by comparing with the PID feedback control before tuning.

articleTitle: Research on the Transient Lightning Current and Magnetic Field Distribution Inside BIPV Buildings under Lightning Strike
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to achieve carbon peaking and neutrality goals, the photovoltaic integrated buildings with BIPV modules is more efficient and economical than other distributed solar energy systems. Since they are usually installed on the roofs of high buildings or big factories, BIPV modules have a high probability of being struck by lightning. In order to study the transient current and magnetic field distribution in the photovoltaic integrated buildings under lightning strike, this paper established a model of photovoltaic integrated buildings with BIPV modules in the FEM simulation platform. The simulation results show that the transient current distribution and the magnetic field distribution inside the photovoltaic integrated buildings are less and more uniform comparing to that of the common buildings without BIPV modules. Therefore, it is revealed that the building with BIPV modules will induce less threat of the lightning electromagnetic impulse to impact the sensitive electronic equipment inside the buildings.

articleTitle: Performance Determination of Induction Machines Utilized in Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The induction machine can be used in renewable energy as a generator. The machine parameters and variables can be represented by equivalent circuit components. These components can be performed by measurements for accurate performance and efficiency determination. These measurements involve per phase supply voltage and current measuring from no load to full load. The no-load test is performed at variable supply voltage. The locked rotor test performs at variable supply frequency. In the present method, the air-gap magnetizing voltage, the machine power factor, the stator, and rotor iron core, and stray loss resistances are accurately determined to achieve excellent accuracy of performance and efficiency calculation of induction machines using the proposed methodology. Also, in the proposed equivalent circuit the skin effect, temperature effect, skew effect, and friction and mechanical losses are considered. The Matlab simulation results are compared with experimental results showing close agreement between these results to validate the proposed equivalent circuit model.

articleTitle: Design Scheme and Effect Analysis of Multi Station Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The integration infrastructure represented by the "multi station integration" mode of substation, data center station, energy storage station, photovoltaic station, charging station, etc. is the future development trend. Firstly, the overall architecture of multi station integration is proposed. Then, starting from the needs of typical parks, the cooling load, heating load, electrical load and other needs are analyzed. Next, typical photovoltaic, energy storage and other capacities are configured. Finally, the effect of the multi station fusion scheme is analyzed. Through the effective allocation of various resources, the energy utilization efficiency has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Electricity Trading Price Mechanism between the Southern Provinces Considering Renewable Energy Development
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, Guangxi will have periodic surplus of electricity; Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangdong which are adjacent to Guangxi have their own characteristics. In order to promote the optimal allocation of energy resources in the Southern Power Grid and fully absorb clean energy, take advantage of Guangxi’s location and combine with the relevant policies of the current electric power system reform, this paper will analyze the demand of Transactions between province, give a benefit distribution mechanism followed the principle that the sending and receiving ends all have a reasonable benefits.

articleTitle: Research on Cooling Technology of Solar Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The temperature rise of solar cells will reduce the service life and efficiency, so cooling technology is very necessary, this paper summarized a variety of solar cell cooling technology, the main cooling technologies of the solar cell, cooling technologies divided into traditional cooling (air cooling, liquid cooling) and the new cooling technology (heat pipe cooling, Liquid immersion cooling, jet impingement cooling, microchannels cooling, etc.), this paper summarized the research related to various scholars solar cell cooling system, introduced various technical advantages and disadvantages; the temperature of fuel cell was simulated by numerical simulation method, and it was found that the cooling technology was very important for the stability of cell, the conclusion is also applicable to fuel cell.

articleTitle: Remote Evaluation Method for Measurement Error of Large-Scale Smart Meters Considering Environmental Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: There are some problems such as high maintenance cost, poor accuracy in smart meters on-site verification. This paper presents a remote evaluation method for the measurement error of large-scale smart meters considering environmental factors. The measurement error model of smart meter considering temperature and humidity factor is established. By calculating the fluctuation percentage of measurement error, the operation error of smart meter in the station area is inferred. Based on the analysis of actual examples, the results show that the method can effectively evaluate the measurement error of smart meters in large-scale stations and improve the accuracy and speed of judgment.

articleTitle: Effects of Cationic Contaminants from Marine Atmosphere on the Diffusion in the Membrane of Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells in Marine Application
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To deal with the air pollution and global warming caused by marine industry due to the use of fossil fuels, the application of proton exchange membrane fuel cells has received a lot of attentions in marine industry. However, the cationic contaminants from marine atmosphere have adverse effects on the performance of fuel cells. The mainly reason is the destruction of the ability of the proton exchange membrane to transfer protons by cationic contaminants. To understand the effects of marine cationic contaminants on the transport performance of the membrane, an all-atom model of cations (Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> and Mg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>) contaminated Nafion 117 membrane is established in this study, and classical molecular dynamics simulations are performed. The diffusion coefficients of cations, water molecules and hydronium ions are calculated using mean square displacements and Einstein’s diffusion law. As expected, the diffusion coefficients of water molecules and hydronium ions are quite smaller than the simulation results without the presence of cationic contaminants. Radial distribution functions and relative concentrations are analyzed to study the interactions between cations and sulfonic groups. It was found that the diffusion coefficient is negatively related to the interaction degree between particles and sulfonic groups.

articleTitle: A Novel Transfer Switch and Control Strategy for Dual Input Power Supplies of Three-phase Electric Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In ship field, to ensure reliable operation of three-phase electric motor, two redundant input power supplies are generally equipped, one works as main power and the other as hot redundancy. When the main power fails, the input power of the motor should smoothly transfer to the standby power. During the transfer process, a comparatively large phase difference between the electromotive force and the standby power supply will cause large surge current far exceeding the direct start-up current of the motor, which will severely damage the motor and shorten its lifetime, so is the case when switching back after troubleshooting. In this paper, a novel transfer switch is proposed with its control strategies detailedly illustrated. This switch could limit the voltage difference within the rated voltage of the motor and meanwhile limit the phase difference within 60°, so the surge current won’t exceed the direct start-up current of the three-phase asynchronous machine. Its effectiveness is verified by experiments carried out on a 10kVA prototype.

articleTitle: Research on the Coordination and Control of Multi-Microgrid with Large-scale Distributed Resource Assess
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increase of distributed energy penetration in medium and low voltage distribution networks, a single regional distribution network may contain multiple microgrids, so the multi-microgrid energy interaction and coordination control technology containing multiple microgrids is urgently needed to be studied. However, there is a lack of research on multi-microgrid collaborative integrated operation scheduling, which fails to consider the impact of interactions among multi-microgrid on the multi-microgrid collaborative operation and has not yet conducted systematic research on its implementation mechanism and application scenarios. To address the above problems, this paper constructs a new multi-microgrid system model and proposes a hierarchical control strategy based on the improved greedy algorithm and SOC status value. Compared with the traditional coordination control strategy, this method can realize the pairwise combination among microgrids, effectively and reliably control the power flow, and significantly improve the stability and distributed energy utilization of multi-microgrid. Finally, build a new multi-microgrid model based on Simulink, select typical working scenarios for simulation analysis, and verify the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient Optimization Configuration System for Hybrid Small Tugs
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The IMO Maritime Environmental Protection Committee (MEPC) adopted the International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL), and ship environmental protection, energy conservation and emission reduction have become the focus of development in the shipping field. However, the actual navigation of the ship working conditions and sea conditions are changeable and uncertain, when the power and speed change, its fuel consumption rate SFOC is affected by the amount of fuel injection, ventilation quality, speed, etc., the best fuel consumption rate SFOC precision point in the actual work of the ship diesel engine is difficult to determine, which is the difficulty of achieving ship fuel saving by controlling the best fuel consumption rate of the diesel engine SFOC. Therefore, this paper optimizes the energy efficiency of hybrid small tugboats, and realizes the operation of power generation diesel engines and low-speed hosts in the minimum SFOC range according to the change of ship speed, the charge/discharge of energy storage battery packs controlled by the reserve power of the ship grid, and the PTI/PTO (electric/power generation) mode of the control shaft with motor M/G.

articleTitle: Economic Operation Optimization of Desulfurization System Based on Improved Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of non-linearity and complex lag of desulfurization system, an improved differential algorithm is proposed to optimize the parameters of desulfurization system. The pH value, slurry density and liquid level height are used as control targets and safety ranges, and emission indicators are used as constraints to make decisions. maximize economic benefits. An adaptive operator is introduced on the basis of the differential evolution algorithm to improve the global optimum. At the same time, the crossover operator is modified to improve the system diversity. The results show that, compared with GA algorithm, PSO algorithm and differential evolution algorithm, the improved differential evolution algorithm can meet the requirements of desulfurization system economy and energy-saving emission, and has guiding significance for desulfurization system decision-making.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of Ultrasonic Monitoring during Lithium-ion Battery Cycling
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Ultrasonic monitoring is a promising method for state estimation and aging characterization in the battery field. Three feature extraction methods focusing on different ultrasonic wave parts during battery cycling are proposed, and each of which has a strong linear correlation with the state of charge. The Principal Components Analysis, which utilizes the entire ultrasonic wave including oscillatory wave and "first echo", extracts the best performing features, improves the resolution of ultrasonic monitoring in the state of charge estimation, and demonstrates the powerful capabilities of ultrasonic monitoring in battery management applications.

articleTitle: Linear Correction Based on Key Factors Exploration on Evaluation Model of Power Grid Project Approval
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: at present, there is a problem of unbalanced power grid construction in Guangxi, which can not meet the people's demand for power support for a better life. Based on the capacity to load ratio, an important indicator of power grid construction projects, this paper puts forward the idea of differentiated capacity load ratio. Combined with the current situation that power grid construction is limited by a single capacity load ratio index, two key influencing factors are found, For the average annual growth rate of electricity and project lag years, the evaluation model of power grid project planning is established, and the grid project approval strategy table is formed. In this paper, the model is applied to a power grid planning and construction, and suggestions on the power grid construction project sequencing are put forward. Through the establishment of the project capacity evaluation model of the power grid, And reasonable adjustment of power grid planning project sequencing, to achieve the scientific control of power grid project approval work, orderly promote the power grid construction project, do a good job in people's pursuit of a better life of electric power support.

Author Keywords: evaluation model of power grid construction project approval

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Modeling Simulation Method of Steam Dynamic Transmission and Distribution Process
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the current lack of dynamic modeling and analysis of steam modeling, the numerical method needs to balance between accuracy and computational efficiency. Based on the basic equation of steam flow, this paper establishes a mathematical model of the hydrothermal process of steam flow. Hydrothermal model is carried out by using a mixture of analytical and numerical methods, and the thermal model is solved by finite difference method for simulation. Compared with the simulation data of commercial simulation software, the solution error of this method is about 0.43%, and the influence of different solution conditions on the thermal process is explored.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Identification under Complex Background Based on Gray Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The complex background causes great interference to the visual recognition of transmission lines. Therefore, a transmission line extraction algorithm which performs well in complex background is urgently needed. This paper uses grayscale iterative filtering to achieve this purpose. Firstly, grayscale processing is performed to obtain a grayscale image that filters out color and brightness interference. Then an improved OTUS algorithm is proposed to remove complex background interference and a gradient enhancement algorithm is used to enhance the contrast between the transmission line and the background. Finally, using Canny edge detection algorithm to extract the edges of the image, then using morphological processing to optimize the Hough transform effect and finally extract the transmission lines. The results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively extract transmission lines under the complex background.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Flow Analysis of an Integrated Energy System Using CloudPSS SimStudio
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As carbon emission management and carbon trading policies have been published in many countries, accurate carbon emission responsibility of energy and power systems, which are the main battlefield of carbon emission reduction, are highly demanded. Since multi-energy flows and energy coupling in the integrated energy system is an interdisciplinary area, an appropriate platform or tool is not available to model, simulate and analyze carbon emission. This paper models and simulates a typical integrated energy park, based on CloudPSS SimStudio platform and the steady-state energy flow and carbon emission flow solver. Potential carbon emission reduction of the park is analyzed based on Sankey diagram of carbon emission flow. Carbon emission pricing is also discussed. This platform provides accurate calculation and management of carbon emission, and visualizes the carbon emission flow. The emission reduction analysis benefits the decision-makers in determining carbon emission policies, prices, etc.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Locating Method of Distribution Network Based on Multiple Objective Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: More and more distributed generators (DGs) are connected to the distribution networks in recent, but complicates fault location process of DNs. To improve the power supply quality of the distribution network with DGs, higher precision and faster fault location methods are needed to adapt to complex network topologies. This paper proposes a fault locating method for the distribution network based on multiple objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO). Firstly, according to the fault current characteristics of distribution networks with DGs, the mathematical model of fault location in the distribution network with DGs is established. And then, the switching function and evaluation function suitable of the distribution network with DGs are constructed. Secondly, the principle of MOPSO is introduced and the flow chart of fault location is analyzed. Finally, a simulation is carried out in the IEEE-33 standard network. The results show that the proposed method can locate single faults and multiple faults correctly under conditions of incomplete FTU fault information, and the accuracy and rapidity of the proposed method are improved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Method for Reflux Power of Modular Multilevel DC Transformer in New Energy Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the power transmission efficiency of modular multilevel DC transformer ( MMDCT ), reduce the current peak during operation, and ensure the safety and stability of MMDCT, this paper proposes a reflux power optimization control method to reduce the reflux power of MMDCT. First, an approximate trapezoidal wave power model calculation method is proposed to simplify the power calculation model. Then, based on the approximate power model calculation method, the reflux power models of MMDCT under single phase shift control and extended phase shift control are calculated, and a reflux power optimization control method under extended phase shift control is proposed. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the control method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Current Spectrum Energy Based DC Arc Detection Method for Distributed PV Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to realize the nation’s goal of achieving carbon peaking before 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2060, the installed capacity of distributed PV power generation systems has increased year by year in China, which increases the probability of DC arc fault. By taking into consideration the different features of DC arc’s unstable combustion stage and stable combustion stage, a DC arc detection method based on current spectrum energy is proposed, which amplifies the fluctuation characteristics of arc current and keeps arc current fluctuating strongly for a long time by shorting circuit the PV array. The spectrum energy in the frequency band of 10kHz~70kHz is calculated through FFT analysis of each PV string’s current, compare the calculated spectrum energy with the set threshold, and then decide whether DC arc fault exists. The results to an experimental platform verify the effectiveness of the arc detection method, which has advantages of low calculation cost and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Configuration of Electric-Hydrogen Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of hydrogen production and storage technology, the development of hydrogen energy storage systems (HESSs) will bring fundamental changes to the structure of modern energy and power system. The combination of HESSs and battery energy storage systems (BESSs) for coordinated optimization can solve the imbalance between supply and demand of various energy sources and thus improve energy efficiency. In order to ensure the effectiveness of HESSs and BESSs planning, aiming at the minimum life cycle cost (LCC), system network loss and tie line switching power deviation, this paper uses multi-objective mayfly optimization (MOMA) to solve the Pareto non-dominated solution set of location and sizing planning schemes of energy storage systems (ESSs). Entropy weight method based grey target decision is used to select the best compromise solution from the Pareto non-dominated solution set. The simulation analysis is carried out based on the extended IEEE-33 node system.

articleTitle: Research on the Learning Bidding Strategy of Bilateral Negotiation Transactions in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The bid of market players in bilateral negotiation transactions is often considered in combination with the opponent’s offer. In order to simulate the actual trading behavior, this paper uses Rubinstein bargaining theory to build a bidding model framework, which puts forward the market trading principles, refines the essential factors such as trading rounds, target price, the concession of the opponent, and bidding style of the primary market entity. This paper designs the discount factor of the model, combines with Bayesian theory to learn the offer of the opponent, dynamically updates and forecasts the bottom line of the opponent's bidding, and forms a learning model Bidding strategy. Through simulation calculation, this paper analyzes the mutual transactions of various bidding styles in the market, and reveals the relationship between the final transaction price and the combination of bidding styles. Learning a bidding strategy can promote the transaction price to evolve in a favorable direction, which is a stable form of market game. The results show the availability of the learning bidding strategy, which is helpful to transaction simulation and market analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Medium-and Long-term Electricity Consumption Forecasting Method Considering Long-term Constraints in Double Carbon Background
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power demand forecasting is an important link in power planning. The conventional electricity consumption forecasting idea is simply based on historical data to extrapolate the trend, which only reflects the historical growth inertia of electricity consumption, without considering the influence of China’s long-term development strategy and energy policy on the growth trend of electricity consumption, which is likely to cause a big deviation between the forecast results and the actual growth trend. Affect the accuracy and credibility of the model. In this paper, we put forward the idea of electricity consumption forecasting considering the constraints of the long-term development scenario, that is, firstly, the annual electricity consumption level of the long-term level is comprehensively judged, then the Logistic curve with saturation characteristics is used to fit the growth process of electricity consumption, and the constraint of the long-term electricity consumption level is added in the parameter identification of the model. The established model can not only accurately reflect the historical growth trend of electricity consumption, but also be consistent with the long-term development trend of electricity consumption. Finally, the predicted value of annual electricity consumption at intermediate level is obtained by using the established model. The above method is applied to the national medium-and long-term electricity consumption forecast, which verifies the feasibility of this method, and has certain reference significance for the electricity demand forecast.

articleTitle: The Influence of Cross-Sectional Features on Heat Transfer and Flow Characteristics of Microcapsule Phase Change Slurry in Wavy Microchannels
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Microchannel heat sinks have been proven to be an effective means of solving small-scale, high heat flux heat dissipation. This research comprehensively evaluates fluids' heat transfer and flow performance in wavy microchannels with different cross-sectional features by establishing heat and mass transfer models in finite element analysis software. And it is innovatively clarified the relationship between the included angle between the microchannel walls and the fluid heat transfer performance. Different characteristic cross-sections with the same hydraulic diameter included circular, hexagonal, rectangular, trapezoidal and triangular. The microcapsule phase change slurry(MPCS) was the heat transfer fluid with 10 wt%. And the performance evaluation indices included Nusselt number, Stanton number, Euler number, thermal resistance, dimensionless temperature, pressure drop, pump power, and maximum temperature. The research results show that the circular microchannel had the largest heat transfer coefficient and heat transfer efficiency. And the heat transfer coefficient of MPCS in circular microchannels was sensitive to changes in velocity at low Reynolds number. The triangular microchannel had the smallest relative momentum loss rate for flow characteristics. But after considering the cross-sectional area of the microchannel, the circular, hexagonal and trapezoidal microchannels all showed lower power consumption. Furthermore, when the cross-section had acute angles, the maximum temperature of the wall surface increased by 7.5-19.5℃. This is because there is an obvious weak flow velocity area near the acute angle, which significantly reduces the heat transfer coefficient near the wall surface. However, the existence of obtuse angles has little effect on the heat transfer performance of microchannels. So the results can provide theoretical support for the design of microchannel heat sinks.

articleTitle: A Division Method of Renewable Energy Generation Cluster
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to maximize the consumption capacity of renewable energy, a cluster division method is proposed in this study. Firstly, a kind of composite indicators including structural indicators and functional indicators is given, where the module degree index based on electrical distance is utilized to measure the structural indicator and renewable energy consumption capacity arising from surplus electricity is utilized to measure the functional indicator. Secondly, genetic algorithm is used as the clustering algorithm, and an improved genetic algorithm based on adjacency matrix and adaptive adjustment of crossover rate and mutation rate is proposed. Finally, taking IEEE 33 node power distribution system as an example, the feasibility of this method is proved.

articleTitle: Power systems monitoring with IEC 61850-9-2 Sampled Values for state estimation with the OpenPMU
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The development of an online tool application that enables precise state estimate via synchrophasor processing tools to receive streams of sampled data from substation merging units via the IEC 61850-9-2 protocol is discussed in this study. This would make it possible for researchers to evaluate synchrophasor technology in a production setting in an entirely open source and transparent manner without the need for intrusive and expensive fixed wiring installations. Users of the platform can simulate a precisely modeled power grid thanks to the platform’s valuable infrastructure capabilities. Real-time simulation tools can be used in a range of applications, providing a wealth of potential for improved testing and prototype review, and this paper proposes a hardware/software integration to monitor state-estimation values and shared such data. The research proposes and employs a flexible methodology for commissioning OpenPMU devices, engaging with other virtual PMUs within the same simulation using Sampled Values to confirm measurement frames and assess estimation with generated data.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Decentralized Stochastic Operation for County Energy Internet with Multi-Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The County Energy Internet (CEI) is an emerging trend of energy utilization under energy transition, which integrates multiple energy resources and microgrids (MGs), and can promote system economy, reliability as well as efficiency. Nevertheless, the operation of the CEI faces challenges and opportunities due to the distinct operational characteristics of subsystems and the privacy-preserving issues among entities. In this paper, a decentralized stochastic operation method is presented to achieve energy and reserve co-optimization and to mitigate the impact of intermittent photovoltaic. Besides, reserve capacity of every independent energy autonomy is determined by chance-constrained programming (CCP), and these probabilistic constraints are transformed into deterministic counterpart based on probabilistic prediction results. Moreover, a decentralized coordination algorithm based on analytical target cascading (ATC) is proposed to coordinate the CEI operator and MG operators with least information sharing. Case study on a CEI with a modified 15-bus power distribution system and a 6-bus district heating system has validated the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Multi-station Fusion Grounding Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To address the safety of grounding network in the operation and maintenance phase after the completion of multi-station fusion, this paper models and simulates the impact characteristics of the grounding network in normal, corroded and fractured states. When the conductor near the lightning injection point of the grounding network corrodes, the ground surface potential difference increases near the corroded conductor, but the other parts do not change much; when the conductor near the lightning injection point of the grounding network breaks, the ground surface potential at the injection point increases significantly, and there is a large potential difference in the ground surface potential distribution of the whole grounding network. A fault diagnosis method based on the ground surface potential and magnetic field distribution is proposed. The fault diagnosis of the grounding network is performed by adding heterodyne excitation currents to the grounding network and detecting the potential and magnetic field distributions generated at the ground surface. Corrosion and fracture can be accurately detected and accurately located in the detection area formed by the current injection and outflow points.

articleTitle: Analysis of Working Fluid Selection for Organic Rankine Cycle System for Waste Heat Recovery
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The selection of reasonable working fluid dramatically impacts the performance of the Organic Rankine Cycle system for the recovery of ship main engine waste heat. In this paper, the Organic Rankine Cycle system (ORC) was used to recover waste heat from the ship’s main engine of the 6G70MEC9.5-HPSCR ship (maximum power 21840KW): According to the engine room working environment requirement, the safety of the working fluid was given top priority. The selection principle of organic work gases was proposed, with the net output work of the system as the index, the system circulation thermal efficiency, and the target parameter (the ratio of the net output work of the system to the total area of the heat exchanger) as the reference. The thermodynamic analysis of the seven organic working fluids that meet the system’s conditions was carried out. The result indicates that as the main engine load increases, the net output work of the ORC system increases, and the cycle thermal efficiency decreases; the working fluid with high critical temperature has a high working ability and poor economy. In the evaporation pressure range of the seven organic working fluids, R365mfc with better work capacity is selected as the suitable circulating fluid for the system.

articleTitle: Study on Working Fluids Selection of a Solar-Assisted Carnot Battery System for Offshore Wind Power Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: There is a long-term mismatch between the power generation and electricity demand of offshore wind power generation, and a supporting energy storage system is required to connect and consume the power of the offshore wind power platform. In this paper, a low-investment solar-assisted Carnot battery energy storage system is designed for offshore wind power platforms, which uses electricity generated from renewable energy (solar energy) to drive a heat pump cycle to store thermal energy in a phase change material in a thermal storage tank. The thermal energy is then transferred to the ORC cycle to generate stable electrical power when needed. In this paper, the thermodynamic model of the system is established, and the boundary conditions are designed according to the actual environment of the offshore wind power platform, and the most suitable circulating working fluid is selected from many aspects. When the low temperature heat pump cycle uses acetone refrigerant and the organic Rankine cycle uses R365mfc refrigerant and when the heat storage temperature is from 130 °C to 160 °C, the power ratio is 89.1% to 130.9%, the equipment cost is low, and its efficiency is low. Therefore, acetone and r365mfc may be the best refrigerant choice.

articleTitle: Coordination of Flexible Resources for Improving Distribution Grid PV Hosting Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The ever-increasing penetration of distributed photovoltaic (PV) poses challenges to the safe and reliable operation of distribution grids, which limit the hosting capacity of PVs. The flexible resources in distribution grids provide potentials to adjust the operation of grids to cope with the uncertainty from the PVs, so that the PV power output can be better accommodated without jeopardizing operation of distribution grids. This paper proposes an optimization model to coordinate various types of flexible resources such as electric vehicles, mobile energy storage, and network reconfiguration, to maximize the accommodation of PVs in an economical manner. A mixed-integer linear programming model is formulated to model the operation characteristics of flexible resources as well as the operational constraints of distribution grid. The proposed model is validated based on IEEE 37-node test feeder and results show that the promotion of PV accommodation can be achieved, which is of great significance to promote the construction of a new power system with new energy as the main body.

articleTitle: Quantifying the Capacity Credit of IDC-based Demand Response in Smart Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the explosive growth of online services, the Internet Data Center (IDC) has been constantly growing, and becoming an emerging load demand in modern power systems. The power consumption of IDCs is believed suitable for demand response (DR) purposes. However, to what extent IDCs could be used as candidate DR resources to provide capacity support are not only dependent on the technical property of IDC equipment but also affected by the willingness of data end-users to participate in the DR program. To address the above issue, this paper presents a methodological framework for quantifying the potential value of IDC-based DR in smart distribution grids. To achieve this, through comprehensive consideration of operational constraints for both data center and power systems, the concept of capacity credit (CC) is introduced and extended into the IDC scenario. The proposed framework explicitly considered the impacts of both uncertainty of user participation intention and the reliability of basic information in the DR process. A novel Z-number based price elasticity uncertainty model is introduced, and then a more realistic evaluation of IDC capacity credit is obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and method is illustrated on a modified IEEE-33 node network, and the obtained results verify the significance of IDC-based DR in enhancing the adequacy of supply in distribution grids.

articleTitle: Integrated Transformer Design for Wide-Range Bidirectional Resonant CLLC Topology
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The on-board charger formed by the bidirectional CLLC resonant topology has high operating efficiency. For the on-board charger with a fixed busbar structure, the bidirectional CLLC topology works in a wide range. The magnetic components in the resonant topology have a large range of operating frequency, high conversion power and high power density. In the water-cooled heat dissipation environment of the on-board charger, the working environment is closed, and it is necessary to analyze the loss and estimate the temperature of magnetic components. This article proposes an integrated transformer structure and design method for the resonant inductor and transformer of the resonant topology. The loss and temperature rise of the entire magnetic component is established. And the optimization process of the integrated transformer is summarized. A 6.6kW on-board charger with bidirectional operation was built to verify the proposed integrated transformer. The volume of the integrated transformer is 185cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: An Electrochemical-Thermal Coupled Model to Simulate the Heat Generation of Lithium-ion Phosphate Batteries
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Heat generated by lithium-iron phosphate batteries often causes safety hazards during the operation and maintenance of energy storage power stations. Analyzing the heating up process of energy storage lithium-ion batteries under different operating conditions helps reduce the heat generated. In this work, a method to couple the electrochemical and the thermal models by compressing and reducing the dimensionality is put forward. Then the coupled model is analyzed with the temperature imbalance characteristics of the battery surface retained. Changes in the surface temperature and temperature distribution of the battery in a single charge-discharge cycle are investigated through experiments. Results prove that the established model accurately simulates heat generation states and temperature changing trends of the energy storage battery during the charge-discharge process. The findings of this work provide approaches to improve the safety of electrochemical energy storage power stations and insights into subsequent explorations of energy storage battery modules.

articleTitle: Research on Terminal Configuration Problem of Distribution Network Automation Based on Single-Objective Optimization Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The main purpose of assembling automation terminals in the distribution network is to reduce the power outage time caused by permanent faults, reduce power outage losses and improve power supply reliability. In order to study the optimal configuration of distribution network automation terminals, this paper firstly studies the power outage time function of the load caused by permanent faults, then proposes the relationship between distribution network automation terminals, power outage losses and power supply reliability, and the optimization of distribution network automation terminals. Secondly this paper proposes the linear model and the non-linear model as a comparison, which adopt the solution of the single-objective optimization model. Finally, this paper conducts analysis on the results, and verifies the rationality of considering multiple automation terminals at the same time, and introduce the concept of effective isolation, and analyze in different LCCs Constrained solution results characteristics and sensitivity to line patrol time, terminal price, terminal operating time and failure rate.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Organic Rankine Cycle Technology to Recover Ship Waste Heat and Construction of Experimental Bench
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the environment that the International Maritime Organization (IMO) will have stricter requirements for ship energy conservation and emission reduction, the use of organic Rankine cycle (ORC) technology to recover ship waste heat for power generation is one of the most promising methods. According to the grade characteristics and distribution characteristics of ship waste heat under different working conditions, this paper theoretically evaluates the feasibility of recovering exhaust gas waste heat, scavenge air cooling waste heat, and jacket cooling water waste heat, and summarizes the application status of using ORC technology to recover ship waste heat. It is proposed that ORC using multiple heat sources to recover is the future development trend. However, the safety of the applicable working fluid, lower actual efficiency, and longer input payback period are still bottlenecks that limit the application of ORC technology on ships. At the same time, for the subsequent in-depth research of ORC technology to recover ship waste heat for power generation, this paper uses a scroll expander as the core part to build an ORC system experimental bench for recovering ship waste heat. R245fa is used as the circulating working fluid. The 120 °C -150 °C high-temperature steam generated by the electric steam boiler and the 70 °C -90 °C hot water generated by the hot water device are used to simulate the exhaust gas waste heat and jacket cooling water waste heat of the marine diesel engine, respectively. The preliminary test results show that the basic ORC system can produce the maximum net output power of 526 W with heat source of 90 °C and hence the bench can work in order.

articleTitle: Short-term Interval Prediction of Wind Speed Using LSTM with Improved Grid Search
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As a clean and inexhaustible renewable energy, wind power attracts more and more attention. However, the intermittence and randomness of wind speed make the utilization of wind power challenging. These troubles can be alleviated via wind speed forecasting that can provide comprehensive future information about wind speed uncertainties. Compared with traditional point forecast methods, interval forecast is able to quantify uncertainties in renewable energy production effectively. In this paper, the idea of prediction intervals (PIs) is employed to capture the uncertainties of wind speed. Specifically, a novel interval forecast model based on long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks is proposed to construct PIs with the lower and upper bound estimation (LUBE) method, which is a powerful nonparametric forecast approach. To tune the parameters of LSTM prediction model, the improved grid search algorithm is introduced as the optimization tool. The effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm is demonstrated by a series of experiments based on a real world wind speed dataset, and the comparative results show the superiority of the model.

articleTitle: Assessment Indices of Marine Power Plants Energy Efficiency and Fouled Ship Hull Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The main functions of a ship intelligent energy efficiency management system are firstly introduced. Based on the external working conditions and fuel calorific value of marine diesel engine, the fuel consumption rate measured onboard ship is corrected, and the energy efficiency assessment indices for marine diesel engine and generator diesel engine are put forward, which are used to evaluate the economy of marine diesel engines. On the basis of fuel calorific value and supplied gas conditions of marine fuel-fired boiler and exhaust gas boiler, the thermal efficiency calculation method for marine steam system and the energy efficiency evaluation index for marine boilers are put forward. Based on the characteristics of ship’s resistances, the evaluation index for fouled ship hull condition is put forward with correcting factors including winds and waves at sea, which is used to quantitatively evaluate the ship’s fouled hull condition. These indices could provide better reference for the development of ship intelligent energy efficiency management system in the future.

articleTitle: Thermal Management of the Passenger Compartment in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Thermal management of the passenger compartment is an important issue for electric vehicles. This paper summarizes current heating and cooling techniques proposed for the car cabin of electric vehicles, which are categorized as the vapor compression refrigeration with electric heating system, the heat pump system and other systems. The advantages and challenges of each system are discussed in detail. Application samples are also provided at the end for better understanding of air conditioning thermal management techniques used in the current market.

articleTitle: Adaptive Substation Load Restoration under Extreme Hot Weather Considering the Flexibility of Air Conditioners
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Load restoration fitting to the change of load amount, available power and outdoor temperature is an important measure to enhance power system resilience under extreme hot weather. A multi-time scale substation load restoration method considering active control of air conditioners is proposed for adaptive restoration. First, a framework of adaptive load restoration is formulated to coordinate the longtime scale whole process scheme making and short-time scale active air conditioners control. Second, an optimization model considering the whole process of substation load restoration is established to make feeder switch schemes to improve load restoration efficiency from the perspective of a long-time scale. Third, model predictive control is adopted to realize the active control of air conditioners from the perspective of a short-time scale to fit the continuously changed load amount, available power and outdoor temperature during restoration. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed substation load restoration method can make schemes adaptively with better restoration benefit under extreme hot weather.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual CAN Bus Hot Redundancy Communication Mechanism Based on Pooling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiency of redundancy strategies such as cold standby redundancy and replication redundancy used in existing dual CAN bus control systems, a design scheme of dual CAN bus hot redundancy communication based on pooling algorithm is proposed in the paper. The frame pool design method is proposed, focusing on the pool-input strategy based on the sending priority, introducing the design idea of the consumption task based on the competing sending mechanism, proposing the timeout pool-output mechanism of the consumption task, and realizing the hot redundant communication of dual CAN bus. The tests show that the design scheme based on this algorithm can achieve hot redundancy of dual CAN bus, which has strong application value in distributed control systems, power systems and automation, etc.

articleTitle: Design of Ship-applied Grid-Connected Synchronverter
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
