abstract: With the increment of distributed power generation in shipboard power grid, grid-connected inverter with automatic output power regulation capability is more and more preferred. As synchronous generator can automatically adjust its output active and reactive power according to frequency and amplitude, it is highly recommended to equate the grid-connected inverter as a virtual synchronous generator. In this paper, modeling of synchronous generator as well as control principle of synchronverter are studied. Design procedure of droop control is detailedly analyzed. The feasibility and effectiveness are validated by simulation carried out on SABER platform.

articleTitle: Development of GPU-Based Efficient Simulation Module of Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The dynamic simulation of the wind farm is important for the construction of a modern renewable energy system. However, for the multi-coupled complex wind farm model, the current wind farm simulation tool is not high efficient enough. Towards this problem, this paper proposed a GPU-based accelerated wind farm simulation module based on FAST.Farm. It focuses on parallelized optimizing the most time-consuming procedure over the calculation. This paper presents the parallelized algorithms for both the most time-consuming procedures (i.e., the gridded wind speed data traversing procedure and the wake plane traversing procedure). Also, the parallelized program for the two procedures is developed based on CUDA. The developed module is verified using a wind farm with 9 wind turbines in the case study. The result shows that its simulation efficiency is significantly improved compared with FAST.Farm, whose speedup has reached 237. Also, the calculation accuracy of the proposed module is guaranteed.

articleTitle: A Model-Based Predictive Control Method of the Ground-Source Heat Pump System for Maintaining Thermal Comfort in Low-Energy Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the increasing demands of energy conservation and emission reduction, the efficient control of indoor thermal environment aims at realizing thermal comfort with the least energy consumption. Taking the ground source heat pump system operated in an ultra-low energy public building as the case study, a physical model was established based on the measured datasets in order to provide databases for training data-driven modeling, which is a model-based predictive control (MPC) model established based on neural network. After calibration, predictions of thermal comfort and loads under different temperature settings were obtained in summer and winter season, based on multiple-dimensional input parameters of time, outdoor temperature and humidity, solar radiation and indoor humidity etc. Afterwards, hourly optimal temperature settings were recommended to take good use of the thermal inertia, and thus provide optimal references for the intelligent operation and control of the ground source heat pump system.

articleTitle: Optimal Design and Experimental Research of a Mixer for Marine Engine SCR System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A new type of swirl plate mixer is designed for the marine low-pressure selective catalytic reduction (SCR) system firstly. And then compared with the baffle type mixer on a marine diesel SCR system, the simulation results show that the new mixer has a better effect. Secondly, the structural parameters of the new mixer were optimized, including spatial arrangement, double-layer mixer settings, mixing blade inclination and mixer pipe size, etc. The simulation results showed that the double-layer swirl plate mixer with increased pipe diameter and 50 degrees inclination angle works best. Finally, an experimental bench was built in the fuel mode of Wärtsilä 20DF engine for experimental verification. The experimental results are basically consistent with the simulation results. The results show that when the conversion rate is equivalent, the escaped NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> ppm of the new swirl plate mixer is much lower than that of the baffle plate , while the amount of escaped NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> is almost equal, the conversion efficiency of the swirl plate type is nearly 50% higher than that of the baffle type mixer. In the D2 test mode, the performance of the new mixer, including the NOx conversion efficiency, mixer pressure drop and NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> escape volume, all meet the design requirements of the marine SCR system.

Author Keywords: the new type of swirl plate mixer

articleTitle: Complement Power Line with Point Movement
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Point clouds captured by LiDAR are widely used in power line maintenance, where the completeness of the point cloud is essential in many applications. Due to the performance of LiDAR equipment, acquisition operations, and other factors, there are missing parts in the captured point cloud of power line. This paper presents a simple but effective method that complements for the missing part of the point cloud with the non-missing part of the power line. By coordinate transformation, the point clouds of all candidate power lines are aligned to the required position. It is very easy to move the transformed points to fill in the missing part of the power line, which can be achieved by only addition and subtraction operations. This paper presents our specific methods of coordinate transformation and point cloud movement for power line complement. The effectiveness of our method is verified by complementing in 59 missing point cloud fragments of the power line.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of a Solar Driven Water Harvesting System for Fabric Evaporation Roof
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Evaporative cooling roof technologies have the benefits of eliminating the urban heat island effect, reducing building cooling loads, and improving the indoor thermal environment. Evaporation roofs are often applied to hot and humid climates due to abundant rainfall resources. However, the cooling efficiency of evaporation roofs was not preferable owing to higher humidity conditions in ambient air. This paper aims to improve the cooling efficiency of wet fiber evaporation roofs and save tap water consumption by experimentally developing a novel water harvesting system for wet fiber roofs. The developed system can harvest water vapor from the humid atmospheric air by silica gel adsorbent. The absorbed water vapor can be further desorbed by solar radiation and then condensed into liquid water by the thermoelectric cooler. It was found that the experimental system was able to acquire liquid water that weighed 130-390 g/kilogram of adsorbent for 24 h. Given the evaporation rate of wet fiber, the efficiency of the water harvesting system was sufficient to meet the evaporation demand for the wet fibre roofs applied to hot and humid climates.

articleTitle: Experimental Study and Hardware Design of Diesel Engine Valve Timing Detection Based on Cylinder Cover Vibrations
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To design an on-line detection device for diesel engine valve timing, experiment was firstly carried out to take measures of vibration signals on the top of exhaust valve cage and phase signal on flywheel end of a two-stroke marine diesel engine. The signals were then analyzed and a new method was put forward for on-line detection of valve opening and closing timing based on the cylinder cover vibration signals. Finally, a set of valve timing detection hardware is designed with single chip microcomputer technology of AD7606 and STM32, including ICP driving circuit and signal conditioning circuit of magnetoelectric sensors. The device adopts STM32 as the main control chip with 8 channels of 16-bit synchronous sampling inputs. Its sampling range is between ± 10 volts and ± 5 volts optionally with up to 200ksps data throughput. This device can realize online detection of intake and exhaust valve timing and online condition monitoring of valve train for different type of diesel engines.

articleTitle: Research on Locking Strategy of Large-Scale Security and Stability Control System under Abnormal State
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the high-speed development of UHV power grid, the characteristics of power grid changed significantly, which puts forward new requirements for the safe operation of power grid and depend on Security and Stability Control System (SSCS) greatly. Based on the practical cases, this paper analyzes the principle of the abnormal criteria of the SSCS and its influence on the strategy of the SSCS, points out the necessity of the research on the locking strategy of the SSCS under the abnormal state. Taking the large-scale SSCS for an example, this paper analysis different control strategies of the stations in the different layered, and puts forward effective solutions to adapt different system functions. It greatly improved the effectiveness and reliability of the strategy of SSCS, and ensure the integrity of the system function. Comparing the different schemes, the principles of making the lock-strategy are proposed. It has reference significance for the design, development and implementation of large-scale SSCS.

articleTitle: Arc Fault Detection and Location Technique Based on State Space Modeling for DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the increasing demand for sustainable energy, the DC microgrid with high penetration of power electronic devices is developing rapidly. The DC arc fault protection technique is essential to ensure the safety of DC microgrids. Although there are arc-fault detectors in the photovoltaic system, their misjudgment rate will increase when it is applied in the DC microgrid with a large number of power electronic devices. Furthermore, the cost will also increase when it is applied in the DC microgrid with many branches. In this paper, a series arc fault detection and location method based on state-space modeling analysis is proposed to realize arc fault detection and location in DC microgrids. Initially, the topology and operation principle of power converters in a DC microgrid is analyzed and the state-space model is developed. In this way, the equivalent circuit of a DC microgrid under normal operation and an arc fault can be established. Since the inductor current and the voltage of the output capacitor in a branch of a DC microgrid under normal operation and arc fault are different, they can be analyzed to determine the operating condition of the branches of a DC microgrid. Thus, the residual of inductor current and voltage of the output capacitor between theoretical analysis and practical measurement can be calculated to detect and locate the arc faults. Besides, the over-threshold values can be integrated to avoid the load transient influence on the arc fault detection. Hence, an arc fault detection and location technique based on state-space modeling and residual analysis is developed. The feasibility and high accuracy of this technique are verified by simulation and experiments in a typical DC microgrid composed of two branches.

articleTitle: SOC Estimation of Liquid Metal Battery Based on BC-FFRLS Online Parameter Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The state of charge (SOC) estimation is a core function in the battery management system. In order to estimate the battery SOC more effectively, the objective of this paper is to add a bias compensation to the original least squares recursive algorithm with forgetting factor, aiming at solving the problem that the battery parameter identification are disturbed by measuring noise. In this paper, an improved algorithm is used to identify the parameters of the battery model online, and then estimate the battery SOC combined with the unscented Kalman filter algorithm. With battery charging and discharging experiment result, the parameter identification methods with and without bias compensation are compared and analyzed. The results show that the improved algorithm has better accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A Spherical Sensor Design for Partial Discharge Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The accident data shows that most electrical equipment failures are accompanied by the occurrence of partial discharge. Through the detection of partial discharge, the early warning of the accident can be realized in a timely and effective manner. Therefore, it is very important to detect whether there is partial discharge in high-voltage lines and electrical equipment. This paper proposes a spherical sensor that can be used for partial discharge detection. The sensor is based on the principle of an electric small antenna, which can be equivalent to a capacitance in the electrostatic field to measure the partial discharge signal. In this paper, the relevant parameters of the spherical sensor are verified by simulink and HFSS simulation analysis, and the detection effect of HFCT is compared through experiments. With its simple production and convenient use, the spherical sensor can replace the HFCT to a certain extent to complete the daily PD inspection work.

articleTitle: Adaptability Research and Practice on Phasing Operation of Hydropower Units in New Energy Intensive DC Near-area
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the voltage support capability of the line commutated converter high voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC) transmission system, this paper proposes to transform hydropower units into phasing operation in new energy-intensive DC near-area, which can not only provide more voltage regulation capability, but also increase the utilization efficiency of hydropower units under the limited condition to save the investment of synchronous condensers. Firstly, the theoretical basis of the phasing operation of hydropower units is analyzed. Then, based on the PSASP simulation of a typical new energy-intensive DC transmission grid in western China, an adaptability analysis is presented, including the sensitivity to overvoltage suppression and the capacity substitution of synchronous condensers. Finally, a work plan for the transformation of hydropower units is proposed to provide technical support for practical work.

articleTitle: Bidding Strategies for Energy Supplier in Multi-time Scale Power and Gas Coupled Market
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy, gas-fired units are gradually replacing traditional coal-fired units, and the coupling between natural gas and power systems is also increasing. This paper proposes bidding strategies for energy supplier in multi-time scale power and gas coupled markets, which also offer ancillary services such as frequency regulation and spinning reserve. Firstly, there exists asynchronous clearing problems in power-gas coupled market, so using the forecasting power generation to clear the gas market. Secondly, taking the gas clearing value as upper limits of gas-fired units to participate in the day-ahead electricity and ancillary service joint market. Then, constructing clustering and scenario reduction models to calculate the unbalanced quantity brought by the uncertainty of renewable energy. The unbalanced quantity is finally cleared in the real-time market with reserve capacity. In case studies, taking the IEEE39-node power system and the Belgian 20-node natural gas system as examples to minimize the energy purchase cost of suppliers and achieve the optimal allocation of resources.

articleTitle: Programmatic Feasibility Discussion on Technologies and Standards for Marine Applications Based on Solid Oxide Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The development of hydrogen fuel cells in the marine and green shipping is prominent in the energy saving and emission reduction. In contrast with the solutions of the low-temperature fuel cells and pure hydrogen fuel, high-temperature solid oxide fuel cells (SOFC) and natural gas fuel scheme can employ economic catalyst and fuel supply with higher efficiency in the combined system. The fuel of nature gas is also more economical and safer for the storage and application than that of pure hydrogen fuel, which are suitable for the long-distance shipping. Accordingly, the feasibility of SOFC and natural gas solution for marine application are investigated in three significant points including marine compact hydrogen reformer, SOFC stack and fuel treatment. The existing codes and standards focus on low temperature fuel cells and less on high temperature solid oxide fuel cells. In view of the current situation of energy saving and emission reduction and the rising interest in SOFC, the shortcomings in its offshore application are discussed for practical application in the future.

articleTitle: A High-Speed IGBT Switching Characteristic Detection System Based on SoC and FPGA Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As an important condition parameter, turn-off time of insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) has a close relationship with junction temperature and device health state. Researches show that it is effective to monitor the health state of IGBT by measuring turn-off time of each switching and junction temperature. However, traditional methods of calculating turnoff time either directly measure collector-emitter voltage or indirectly measure gate side parameters, which may have risks on safety and problems of complexity. In order to overcome these problems, in this paper, an IGBT switching characteristic detection system based on system-on-chip (SOC) is proposed, which takes IGBT turn-off time and output current as switching characteristic, and features in high-speed calculation (in microsecond level) of turn-off time in real time. The system uses a non-contact turn-off time calculating method to monitor the health state of IGBT in an online way and improves its performance by field programmable gate array (FPGA) acceleration on ZYNQ SoC. Compared with the existing technology, it has the advantages of high security, high performance and simple engineering implementation. Finally, the feasibility of the system is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Investigation on Performances of a Solid Oxide Fuel Cell Stack with Insulation Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In practical applications of solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs), thermal insulation layer is required to wrap the SOFC stacks in order to reduce heat dissipation to the environment and maintain the high operating temperature. However, most of the current experimental and numerical studies are usually for SOFC stacks placed in a furnace without insulation material. In this study, the thermal and electric performances of a SOFC stack with insulation layer and that placed in a furnace are numerically compared. The influences of insulation layer thickness and reactant gas inlet temperature on the temperature distribution and polarization curve of the stack are investigated. The maximum and minimum temperatures in the stack and range of output current densities are discussed at different operating conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Method for Battery Energy Storage Based on Adaptive Time Granularity
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the integration of many intermittent and distributed new energy sources into the power grid, the safe and stable operation of the power system is facing huge challenges. HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning, HVAC), electric vehicles (EV), and battery energy storage (BESS) can be a solution to this problem due to high flexibility and strong controllability. Aiming at the problem of power imbalance caused by large-scale wind power integration, this paper proposed an optimal scheduling method of HVAC and BESS based on adaptive time granularity. Time granularity is critical to the optimization of scheduling methods, which is decided by the load fluctuation in this paper. The simulation results showed that reducing the time granularity can smooth the fluctuation of the tie-line but would increase the scheduling cost and the amount of calculation.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Photovoltaic Grid Connection on Distribution Network Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For the impact of more and more PV distributed access to the distribution network on the voltage stability of the system, the mechanism of the impact of PV distributed access on the voltage stability of the distribution network is analyzed. By calculating and analyzing the voltage stability of PV access to the distribution network under different locations and weather conditions through actual system calculations, an IEEE7 node simulation model of distributed power access to the distribution network is established, and the voltage fluctuations of the distribution network under different access capacities and different access points of distributed power are simulated and analyzed, and the influence law of distributed power access to the distribution network voltage fluctuations is obtained. The research results in this paper can provide effective theoretical reference and technical guidance for the access of distributed power sources in distribution networks.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Pressure and Temperature Responses in LNG Fuel Tanks under Rolling Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: LNG fuel tanks undergo rapid pressure drop after pressurization and lead to unstable LNG supply rates. This paper presents a numerical investigation on the pressure and temperature responses in the LNG fuel tank after pressurization, and analyzes the effects of rolling motion on the thermal response of LNG fuel tank. The results indicate that the pressure drop is significantly affected by the rolling frequency, especially when the rolling frequency is closer to the intrinsic frequency. The increase of rolling frequency also shortens the time required to reach the thermal equilibrium in the LNG tank. With the increase of the liquid filling rate, the drop process of the tank pressure and vapor temperature is accelerated.

articleTitle: Intelligent Operation and Maintenance System of Air Conditioner in Switch Station Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that real-time monitoring and remote fault diagnosis cannot be realized in the operation and management of air conditioning in the switching station of Shanghai power grid, a set of maintenance service management system centered on operation and maintenance is designed and implemented to realize the functions of comprehensive monitoring of system parameters such as temperature and humidity and equipment status, fault alarm and push, improving operation and maintenance efficiency and reducing operation and maintenance and labor cost. Starting with the purpose and significance of the system, this paper systematically introduces the specific composition, working principle and significant value of the system, makes a feasibility study and analysis, and briefly explains the specific installation, which is of great significance to realize the improvement of standardization and transparency of air conditioning operation and maintenance, intelligent control and energy utilization.

articleTitle: Research on Expansion Capability Evaluation of Multi-Station Integration Considering Internal and External Collaborative Matching
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Multi-station integration is an important way to carry out function reuse in substations, which can revitalize the superior resources of substations and expand emerging businesses of power grid companies. This paper presents an evaluation method for the expansion capability of substations. This paper firstly investigates the resource requirements of data center stations, energy storage stations, charging and swapping stations, distributed photovoltaic stations, 5G base stations, and Beidou ground reference stations from the perspectives of space, power, and communication. Then, the evaluation index and evaluation method of resources in substation are proposed. Finally, with an example of a substation, three possible expansion capability schemes are listed.

articleTitle: Prediction of Hourly Subentry Energy Consumed in a Typical Public Building Based on Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: During the operation and maintenance management, accurate energy consumption forecasts can provide valuable energy saving strategy for decision makers. This paper proposes a hourly data-driven prediction model of building subentry energy consumption based on pattern recognition. Firstly, the typical energy consumption patterns of air conditioning, lighting and sockets were extracted by K-Means algorithm, and then the random forest algorithm was used to match the corresponding patterns for the prediction day, and finally the neural network algorithm was used to establish a time-by-hour energy consumption prediction model within the corresponding energy consumption pattern. The above model is verified by taking the subentry consumption data of air conditioning, lighting and sockets of an office building in a hot summer and warm winter region as the research object. The result shows that the prediction model based on pattern recognition has greatly improved the prediction accuracy and stability compared with the direct energy consumption prediction model, among which the relative error of the air conditioning increased by 75.26%, the CV value increased by 46.90%, the lighting’s relative error and CV value increased by 40.19% and 31.11%, the socket’s relative error and CV value increased by 28.59% and 39.79% respectively.

articleTitle: Structural Design of the Thermoelectric System Based on Industrial Thermal Environment Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Thermoelectric (TE) conversion is a green energy technology that directly converts heat into electricity based on the Seebeck effect of materials. It has been extensively studied in the fields of industrial waste heat recovery and renewable resource utilization. In this study, a TE plate with high practical value was designed and constructed by analyzing the thermal conditions of the industrial environment. Moreover, the field test method is used to verify the feasibility of the industrial application of the TE plate. The results show that the TE plate has better power generation performance when it adopts the contact working mode. The power generation per unit area is about 2.8kW•h/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> when the hot end temperature is 205°C. The TE plate has a poor ability to absorb radiant heat. It is necessary to install a heat collector on the hot end of the plate in actual work. The average output power of the TE plates installed in Zone A of the steel bar production line is 83.9W. The power generation per unit area is about 1.3kW•h/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which can be used for grid-connected power generation.

articleTitle: Research on Resonant Frequency of Reradiation Interference from Power Transmission Lines below 1.7MHz Based on Characteristic Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To clarify the reradiation interference resonance mechanism of transmission lines is the key to solving their passive interference problems. In view of the existing problems in the research methods of passive interference resonance of transmission lines based on antenna theory, the concept of eigenmode is introduced in this paper. Then the electromagnetic scattering problem of transmission lines under external excitation is transformed into the analysis its characteristic modes and related parameters. From the perspective of electromagnetic energy, the resonance mechanism of reradiation interference of transmission lines below 1.7MHz is explained, and the correctness of the method in this paper is verified by comparing with the IEEE standard.

articleTitle: Research on Compensation Method of Power Auxiliary Service with Stable Power Cut-off Including New Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At the end of 2021, the National Energy Administration issued the administrative measures for electric power auxiliary service, which included the stable control and switching machine into the compensation scope of electric power auxiliary service, and required that the compensation intensity should be determined according to the principle of "compensation cost and reasonable income" by comprehensively considering the cost, performance and reasonable income of electric power auxiliary service. According to the above principles, this paper deeply analyzes the investment, construction, operation and maintenance costs of the power plant stability control device, the loss of less power generation caused by the shutdown of the power plant stability control device ,the increased restart and grid connection costs, and proposes three compensation aspects: the standby compensation for the stability control and shutdown, the compensation for the loss of less power generation and the compensation for the unit restart and grid connection costs, and establishes the mathematical model and calculation module of the power auxiliary service compensation for the stability control and shutdown, the architecture of compensation calculation system for auxiliary service of stable control cutting machine is proposed. For three types of power plants, namely thermal power, hydropower and wind power, a detailed statistical analysis is carried out on the construction and operation cost of the power plant stability control device, the loss of less power generated by the unit cut-off and the unit restart cost to determine the reasonable compensation intensity. The research results will serve as an important reference for the compensation method and strength of the power auxiliary service of the stability control and switching machine in China Southern Power Grid.

articleTitle: Analysis of Impedance Characteristics Based on Lithium-ion Battery at Different States
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The charge state and temperature of a lithium-ion battery are related to the cell impedance, which characterizes the electrochemical properties. To study this problem, a battery simulation model is established based on the second-order RC equivalent circuit model, in which the steady-state circuit is actively perturbed to analyze the relationship between the excitation signal and the response signal, and the system transfer function of the corresponding parameters is established by analyzing the system block diagram to verify the accuracy of the frequency response of the battery simulation model; then the frequency response data of the battery model in different states are obtained, and the conclusion that the influence of temperature on the impedance characteristics is more obvious than that of SOC(State of charge) is proved through analysis.

articleTitle: Carbon Emissions Constraint Distributed Low-carbon Economic Dispatch of Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to meet the emission reduction requirements of integrated energy power system, the global inequality constraint is added to the economic dispatch model to reduce the carbon emission of the system by regulating the output of the unit, but it is difficult to achieve distributed solution. In order to solve the distributed low-carbon economic scheduling problem with global inequality constraints, a distributed economic scheduling solution method is proposed based on the existing research results. This method is based on dual theory and variable decomposition method to decompose it into sub-problems related to each virtual power generation unit (Agent). The alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM) algorithm is used to realize distributed economic scheduling through the exchange and iteration of Lagrange multiplier information between adjacent Agents, and meet the demand of "plug and play" of the optimization unit. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an IEEE-6-bus system.

articleTitle: Analysis and Verification of Seebeck Effect and Peltier Effect Co-existence on a Thermoelectric Device
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Thermoelectric conversion can directly use thermal energy to generate electricity, a promising green waste heat recovery technology. It has been applied to medium- and low-temperature waste heat power generation in the industry. However, it is found that some components in the series thermoelectric module group are not working, and the power generation components are transformed into power consumption components due to the uneven temperature distribution of the heat source. The co-existence of the Seebeck effect and the Peltier effect appears in the circuit. In this study, the experimental bench with a thermoelectric module group, a heat source, and a water-cooling system was established, the power generation under different working conditions was tested, and the coexistence of the Seebeck effect and the Peltier effect was verified. The results show that the thermoelectric module group has excellent power generation performance when the temperature distribution of heat source is uniform. As the temperature of one heat source decreases, the output power curve is inversely proportional. When the heat source temperature difference exceeds 70K, there is an obvious inflection point in the output power curve, proving that the Seebeck effect and the Peltier effect exist simultaneously. This result has a guiding role in the practical application of thermoelectric conversion technology.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Load Control Method Based on New Generation Distribution Automation System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the development form of new distribution system under the background of peaking carbon dioxide emissions and achieving carbon neutrality and the digital lean management and control requirements of the new generation of distribution automation system, this paper studies and proposes a load accurate control method based on the new generation of distribution automation system. Based on the model and data of the new generation distribution automation system, considering the supporting capacity of distributed resources, this method establishes a multi-time scale load accurate control strategy resource pool generation model, which trains the load accurate control strategy by using particle swarm optimization method offline, and generates load accurate control strategy by combining real-time online data, and provides it to the distribution automation system to realize load accurate control according to the voltage drop target, The proposed method is verified by an actual example in a city and the results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the economic loss caused by load shedding, reduce the safety risk of remote control operation and the operation time of power rationing, and improve the ability of accurate load regulation of distribution network.

Author Keywords: new generation of distribution automation system

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Pulverizing System Based on Adaptive Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To improve the anti-disturbance capability of the pulverizing system in thermal power plants, considering the safety of pulverizing system equipment, this paper proposes a control algorithm based on adaptive dynamic programming. The algorithm solves the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation by constructing a cost function, and then continuously updates the optimal control strategy through policy iteration. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the ability to resist various disturbances that the system may face, ensure that the pulverizing system can run in a better state, and ensure the economy, environmental protection and stability of the unit operation.

articleTitle: Simulation and Characterization of RSOFC Sintering Process by Coarse-grained Molecular Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Reversible solid oxide fuel cell (RSOFC) has the bi-functional working ability of power generation and fuel production, to reduce pollution and greenhouse gas emissions and store fuel, providing a feasible solution to balance the energy supply and demand for both traditional and new energy. In this paper, a three-layers integrated design with symmetrical composite electrode structure is proposed for stress minimization and structure simplification. The coarse-graining method combined with the core-shell model is used to predict the structure evolution of nano-particles LSCM and YSZ to understand the sintering behaviors and mechanisms in the sintering process. The effects on the three-phase boundary (TPB) length, specific volume surface area (Av), and thermal-physical properties of the composite material are studied. It is found that higher thermal compatibility is achieved by increasing the proportion of LSCM, the TPB is increased by increasing the sintering temperature, Av is increased when smaller-sized particle is employed, which are beneficial to improve the working performance for RSOFC.

articleTitle: Power Business Routing Optimization Algorithm Considering Overall Balance of Network Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Real-time business is crucial to the security and stability of the power system. The routing planning of power business should give priority to the performance requirements of real-time services and achieve the overall balance of network performance. This paper presents a routing optimization algorithm based on fuzzy Q-Learning. The algorithm fuzzifies the link saturation and link importance, and evaluates the link status by establishing a fuzzy logic system. Taking the power business as the agent, the return value is calculated according to the link state. At the same time, considering the service bandwidth and delay requirements, it guides the agent to continuously interact with the environment and find the best route to meet the service requirements. The simulation test shows that the algorithm is an effective route optimization method for power business, which can conduct route planning from a global perspective, and effectively meet the delay demand of real-time business. It achieves the balanced distribution of link importance and link saturation in the whole network.

articleTitle: Optimization for EV Fuse Based on Thermal-electrical Coupled Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Fuses play an important role in protection of the power and electrical components. This work is aimed at reducing the pre-arcing time of fuse by optimizing the fuse-element structure. A three-dimensional (3-D) finite element simulation model of fuse was established, and the temperature variation of fuse was simulated with the thermal-electric coupling method. On this basis, the optimal structure of fuse-element was determined and analyzed. The results show that temperature change rate and maximum temperature threshold of the fuse-element can be regulated through altering the structure of fuse-element. With the improvement of the fuse-element, the pre-arcing time can be reduced by approximately 4 ms. The simulation results can be used to guide the actual fuse design.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Analysis of a Transcritical Carbon Dioxide Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of energy storage technology, a transcritical carbon dioxide energy storage (TC-CES) system based on liquid and supercritical storage is proposed. The system has the advantages of high energy storage density, no geographical restrictions, and promoting carbon dioxide emission reduction. To explore the mechanism of the working parameters of TC-CES system on the thermodynamic performance, a mathematical model of the system was established. Using Aspen plus and MATLAB software to simulate the process, the thermodynamic characteristics of the system are analyzed, and the influence of energy storage pressure and energy release pressure on the energy efficiency of the system is deeply studied. The results show that the cycle efficiency of the system is 53.8%, the energy storage density is 21.1kW•h/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and the heat utilization efficiency is 77.9%; The energy storage pressure has different effects on compressors and turbines of different stages; When the energy storage pressure increases from 12MPa to 26MPa, the energy storage density increases but the cycle efficiency decreases gradually, but there is an inflection point at 24MPa; By reducing the energy storage pressure to 12MPa, the maximum cycle efficiency is 55.6%; The increase of energy release pressure is beneficial to improve the cycle efficiency, but attention should be paid to the selection of energy storage density.

articleTitle: Design and Operation Control of an Integrated Wind Power Generator with Wind Sails
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Facing the increasingly serious energy crisis and the growing environmental problems, the completely pollution-free wind energy is a feasible solution. An integrated device for sail navigation and wind power generation was proposed, which adopts a circular arc-shaped sail and can unify the functions of navigation and power generation with little impact on the stability and maneuverability of the ship, and can realize the all-weather utilization of wind energy. In addition, the generator can select different parameters of the circular arc sail according to the navigation characteristics of the ship, so as to maximize the use of wind energy.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Suspension Stability of Phase Change Microcapsule Suspensions
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The stratification problem of phase change microcapsule suspensions seriously affects their heat transfer performance enhancement and plagues their practical applications. The agglomeration between microcapsule particles is one of the main reasons for their stratification. According to the colloidal shear thinning effect, the shear force generated by stirring can destroy the agglomeration. In this paper, we investigated the effect of different stirring times and rates on the stratification pattern of phase change microcapsule suspensions formulated with paraffin phase change microcapsule particles (phase change temperature of 5-7 °C) after stratification by prolonged resting and restoration of suspension characteristics by stirring. The results show that the stirring time and stirring speed have positive effects on the maintenance of suspension of phase change microcapsule suspensions to a certain extent, but attention should be paid to the damage to the microcapsules during stirring. The results of the study have contributed to the enhanced heat transfer in phase change microcapsule suspensions as well as to the material lifetime.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Assessment of Primary Frequency Regulation Capability for Doubly-Fed Wind Turbines Using Kinetic Energy of the Rotor
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: When wind turbines participate in primary frequency regulation by releasing the kinetic energy of the rotor, the primary frequency response capacity (PFRC) varies with the fluctuation of operation conditions, especially the wind speed. Probabilistic Assessment of PFRC is required to provide basis for power system operation planning and control strategy formulation. A simplified analytical model of frequency response considering the dynamic variation of rotor speed was established. Based on the analytical solution of PFRC, the influence of wind speed on the PFRC was analyzed. Point estimation and Gram-Charlier series expansion were used to obtain the probabilistic distribution characteristics of PFRC with wind speed fluctuation. The accuracy of the model and the effectiveness of the proposed probabilistic evaluation method were verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Effect of Waste Cooking Oil Biodiesel on Marine Diesel Engine Performance, Emissions and Combustion Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The consumption rise and environmental impact of diesel fuel lead to the exploration of alternative fuels. This work investigated the effects of blending waste cooking oil biodiesel with diesel on marine diesel engine performance, combustion characteristics and emissions compared to diesel. The rapid combustion of biodiesel reduces the effective thermal efficiency (BTE) and results in a slight increase in fuel consumption rate (BSFC). The levels of carbon monoxide (CO), carbon dioxide (CO2), sulfur dioxide (SO2) and soot in the gaseous pollutants reduces when blending biodiesel. However, the high combustion temperature and oxygen content in the cylinder increased nitrogen oxide (NOX) emissions. Diesel fuel and all blends exhibit nearly the same value of cylinder peak pressure. Waste cooking oil biodiesel blended can be considered good alternatives for fuels in diesel engines due to their improvements in performance parameters, combustion characteristics as well as emissions reduction.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Finite-time Trajectory Tracking Control System for Underactuated Surface Vessels with Event-Triggered Input
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper designs a finite-time trajectory tracking control system with event-triggered input for underactuated surface vessels(USVs) which are influenced by dynamic uncertainties, unknown time-varying disturbances and limited communication resources. In this system, the virtual reference heading is obtained by performing norm inverse calculation on the virtual control of sway and surge, and a new kinematic error equation is constructed based on this. Then, the internal dynamic uncertainty and the external time-varying disturbance in the system are compounded linearized, and the upper bound of the compound uncertainty term are approximated by adaptive technology. Combined with the finite-time control theory, the kinematic virtual control is optimized, and the finite-time control law is obtained. Through the event-triggered technology, the control frequency of the system is limited to ensure the effective use of communication resources. Finally, the design process of the whole system is strictly analyzed, and the performance of the system is effectively verified by two sets of simulations.

articleTitle: Study on Low-order Voltage Harmonic Behavior in Isolated Islands Formed by Distributed Photovoltaic Power
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of photovoltaic generation connected power grid, when more and more power generation systems are linked to the power grid, a new phenomenon of power grid protection - island effect appears, and its harm cannot be ignored. By analyzing the voltage and frequency characteristics of grid connected photovoltaic power supply before and after islanding, it is found that when the power balance, voltage, frequency, impedance and phase criteria fail before and after islanding, the sum of low-order voltage harmonics changes significantly. After comparing the loads with different quality factors, the islanding criterion of low order harmonic voltage is proposed, as further enriches the judgment method of islanding. This method has the advantages of simple principle, easy implementation and no impact on power quality. The test and simulation results are consistent with the islanding criterion.

articleTitle: Dynamic Data Modeling of Industrial System Based on Improved Bird SWARM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the initial state of industrial system cannot be obtained in the process of data-driven modeling, a modeling method based on improved bird swarm algorithm and initial state optimization was proposed. The method described in this article on industrial system operation process in the historical data of dynamic data as the modeling data, by modeling the system at the end of the data input values of input of the system steady state component, with the system output steady state component, system initial state, the starting point of modeling data model parameters for the optimization of particle dimension, the application of the improved algorithm for optimization, system model is established. The modeling and simulation results of an industrial system show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Proposal and Performance Analysis of a Novel Combined Cooling and Power System for Waste Heat Recovery of Marine Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Recovering the waste heat of the marine engine is a promising way to save fuel consumption and reduce carbon emissions. This paper proposed a combined cooling and power (CCP) system, which is consisted of a regenerative sCO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> Brayton cycle (RSCBC), an organic flash cycle (OFC) and an ejector refrigeration cycle (ERC). The comparative analysis between the proposed system and single RSCBC shows that the proposed system owns a higher energy efficiency (31.40% VS 28.84%) and exergy efficiency (57.87% VS 53.98%) under base conditions, confirming the performance improvement. Finally, the optimization analysis result shows that the proposed system could achieve the maximum exergy efficiency of 59.35% with the power and cooling outputs of 318.27 kW and 44.51 kW, respectively.

articleTitle: DC Arc Fault Detector Based on Wavelet Transform for DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasing capacity of power generation from renewable energy in the power grid, the development of a DC microgrid system is dramatical. In a DC microgrid system, an arc fault can be caused by loosening connection of conductors, aging and damage of insulations. It is an extremely harmful potential fault in a DC microgrid. But, a reliable arc fault detector for the DC microgrid is still lacking. A DC microgrid composed of a large number of branches has a complex structure and the operation condition varies with the branches. Though there are existing DC arc-fault detectors, most of them are developed for DC systems with a simple structure and limited operating conditions. There are few mature industrial products for the DC microgrid. Therefore, it is significant to study the characteristics of DC arc faults and develop a reliable arc fault detector for DC microgrids. In this paper, the potential arc faults in a DC microgrid are emulated. The characteristics of DC arc current in the time domain, frequency domain, and time-frequency domain are investigated. According to the characteristics of arc faults, the wavelet transform is evaluated to extract the arc fault features in the time-frequency domain. In this way, a cost-effective arc fault detector is developed for DC microgrids. It can improve the safety and efficiency of a DC microgrid.

articleTitle: Double-Layer Day-Ahead Optimal Scheduling of Microgrid Considering Flexible Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to deal with the volatility and uncertainty of renewable energy sources and loads such as wind and solar in the microgrid system, microgrids have begun to access diversified flexible resources, and how to coordinate flexible resources also brings new opportunities to the optimization and dispatch of microgrids. challenge. Based on this, this paper first studies the multi-energy coordination and complementarity characteristics of various flexible resources on the source network and load side, and analyzes the demand-side and supply-side flexible resource models from the perspective of supply and demand balance. Secondly, considering factors such as the uncertainty of load and wind and solar output, establish a microgrid day-ahead optimal scheduling model with the lowest loss of load rate, optimal user cost and operating cost as the goal, taking into account reliability and economy, and apply the improved MOEA /D algorithm solves, and obtains the Pareto optimal solution set of the day-ahead scheduling plan. Finally, the simulation results of an example verify the rationality and effectiveness of the optimization method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Influence of Layouts on the Fully-developed Wind-Turbine Array Boundary Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: When the streamwise scale of the wind farm exceeds an order of magnitude of the atmospheric boundary layer height, it becomes the fully-developed wind farm, which is an important theoretical model to study the flow mechanisms of large wind power plants. However, existing studies are only focused on the regular wind farm layout, and the influence of the layout on the flow characteristics, vertical structure, and mean kinetic energy budget of the atmospheric boundary layer is still not well understood. To this end, we utilize high-fidelity large-eddy simulation to investigate the influence of layout with different wind turbine densities. The results show that layouts can significantly influence the local flow features around wind turbines and flow inhomogeneity of the wind farm, but the influence is limited to the inner layer and wake layer. With the same wind farm density, the mean relative equivalent roughness height difference is only 6.5% and the power harvested difference by wind turbines is about 5.1% between different layouts.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Frequency Support Scheme for Offshore Wind Farms Connected with Low Frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the grid connection of an offshore wind farm, flexible low-frequency AC transmission technology has received special attention. With the increasing penetration of grid-connected offshore wind farms, it is of great importance that the offshore wind farm can provide frequency support to the bulk power grid to help solve its frequency stability problem. However, the offshore wind turbine is decoupled from the onshore bulk power system by the back-to-back converter, which plays the central role in the low-frequency power transmission technology. Therefore, the offshore wind farm cannot react to the change in frequency of the shore power grid. To this end, this paper proposes a frequency support strategy for a low-frequency transmission system integrated offshore wind farm, which has seldom been studied in existing literature. First, a mapping strategy is developed to establish the connection between the frequencies of the onshore bulk power system and the low-frequency transmission system. A dual loop based strategy is developed for the back-to-back converter. Finally, a droop control based strategy is developed to control the active power of the wind turbine, which will provide frequency support for the bulk power system. The simulation results show that with the method proposed in this paper, the offshore wind farm can provide effective frequency support in response to the frequency change of the onshore bulk power system.

articleTitle: Framework Design and Energy Storage Optimal Planning of Tunnel Power System for Zero-Carbon Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Heavy energy consumption of tunnels has caused great pollution and carbon emission. To realize the low-carbon transformation of tunnel power systems, this paper designs a framework for the tunnel power system and proposes an optimal method for energy storage capacity. First, the framework is proposed based on multiple power complementation and bidirectional interaction between supply and demand, and the advantages and disadvantages of ground /underground energy storage are compared. Then, a bi-level optimization model is proposed by analyzing the capacity planning and dispatching strategy. Finally, one case is performed to analyze the effectiveness of the proposed framework, and the notable advantages of the underground energy storage in terms of economy, low carbon, and social benefits are verified.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Solar Absorption Cooling System for Heat Recovery in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing demand for energy saving in the data center, heat recovery in data centers has received wide attention because of its characteristics of energy consumption reduction and economic benefits. In this study, a hybrid solar absorption cooling system is proposed for data centers to improve waste heat utilization in different seasons and reduce system energy consumption. The waste heat from the water-cooled racks is used for district heating and cooling production. Solar thermal collectors are installed to improve the quality of the waste heat. In addition, natural cooling is preferentially used in winter to reduce system energy consumption. The system performance is simulated in a data center in Tianjin. The results show that 40.2% of the waste heat from the water-cooled racks can be used in district heating. With the limitation of the roof area and the intermittency of the solar, only 5.7% of the cooling demand of the air-cooled racks can be met by the absorption chiller. If the absorption chiller operates continuously at higher a hot water temperature, the waste heat utilization ratio can be increased to 36% and energy saving can be achieved by 24%. As a result, the economic performance becomes more promising and the payback period will be reduced to 8 years. This study can provide theoretical support for heat recovery in data centers.

articleTitle: Research on Non-invasive Portable Partial Discharge Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In GIS, switch cabinet, transformer and other equipment suspected defects or in the period of power protection, need real-time status monitoring. This paper integrates partial discharge detection methods such as ultrasonic detection, UHF detection and high frequency current detection, designs a non-immersion portable partial discharge monitoring system, and puts forward the corresponding monitoring process. The effectiveness of the system has been verified by field cases. It can be widely used in tracking and monitoring of suspected defects of substation equipment and main equipment of power protection, as well as real-time perception of equipment status and development trend, which provides an important supporting basis for equipment status evaluation and maintenance decision making.

articleTitle: Optimization of Heat Dissipation Fins of Portable Fuel Cell Hydrogen Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the low heat dissipation efficiency of portable fuel cell hydrogen generator a fin optimization scheme based on an orthogonal test is proposed. At first, we use UG software to build the three-dimensional model of fuel cell hydrogen generator; Next, the heat dissipation performance of three kinds of fins with different shapes is analyzed and designed by using 6SigmaET software, and the optimal fin shape is obtained; Finally, combined with the orthogonal test, an orthogonal test table is designed, which takes the fin spacing, height and thickness as factors, and the maximum temperature of the hydrogen generator and the weight of the heat dissipation fins as evaluation indicators to optimize the structure. Moreover, both the maximum temperature of the hydrogen generator and the weight of the heat sink were reduced and the results were ideal.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Super-hydrophilic Self-cleaning Coating in Photovoltaic Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Photovoltaic modules are installed in outdoor environment and the surface is prone to dust accumulation, which leads to problems such as hot spot effect, power performance degradation and module surface corrosion. Certain measures need to be taken to ensure the cleanliness of the module surface. However, the method of spraying self-cleaning paint on the surface of photovoltaic modules to enable photovoltaic modules to have self-cleaning capabilities has great advantages over traditional cleaning methods due to its high reliability and low cost. In this paper, a photovoltaic power station is selected to test the application effect of super-hydrophilic self-cleaning coating. According to the result, this paper analyzed its power generation gain and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Short-term power forecasting model of floating photovoltaic—A case study of Huainan floating photovoltaic plant, China
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Although the development of floating photovoltaic (FPV) in China is rapid, there are few reports on the power generation forecasting of FPV. Based on the monitoring data of the 150MW FPV plant in Huainan, a short-term power forecasting model for FPV plant is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the input variables of deep belief network (DBN) are selected based on the open-source R programming software; then, wavelet transform is used to decompose the power time series into several components with different frequencies, and convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to extract the nonlinear features and invariant structures of each component; finally, the back propagation neural network (BPNN) optimized by genetic algorithm (GA) is used to integrate the outputs of CNN and DBN to obtain the final PV power forecasting value. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper can obtain superior forecasting accuracy than other models.

articleTitle: Operation Simulation of Energy Storage Providing Flexibility under Market Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the construction of power system with high penetration of renewable energy and the application of energy storage technology, building a capacity market to meet the adequacy of power capacity has received increasing attention. In this paper, a capacity market operation mechanism with bi-level optimization of capacity market and spot market is proposed, and the market simulation operation results when energy storage costs and variable renewable energy (VRE) fluctuation change are given, which can provide suggestions for improving market operation efficiency.

articleTitle: Two-Layer Optimal Scheduling of CHP Microgrid Considering Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Optimal management of electric vehicle (EV) charging and discharging can greatly improve the operation economy and reduce the power supply pressure during the peak load period. In view of the economic operation problem of combined heating and power (CHP) microgrid considering EV charging and discharging, this paper establishes a two-layer optimization scheduling model. The first layer aims to minimize the variance of load curve and minimize the dissatisfaction of EV owners, and the second layer modifies superior results based on real-time predicted power and unplanned EV behaviors. Furthermore, this paper proposes multi-objective improved sparrow search algorithm (MISSA) to solve the high-dimensional, nonlinear and multi-objective model. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can achieve win-win situation between EV owners and microgrid operators, and the operation cost is reduced by 6.29%, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Micro-combined Heating and Power System with PEM Fuel Cell System for Household
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Micro-combined heating and power system of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (mCHP-PEMFC) as a green clean heat supplied and distributed energy system has a huge advantage in improving the traditional energy utilized method and energy step utilization. In this paper, we analyzed the electric and thermal demand of domestic residential and studied the operation mode of PEMFC in household. We designed a 1.5kW mCHP-PEMFC system and analyzed its thermoelectric output characteristic and economic performance, which provides a reference to integrated system research of household mCHP system.

articleTitle: Dual-Integral Sliding-Mode Maximum Power Point Tracking for Photovoltaic Systems under Partial Shading
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: When the photovoltaic array system encounters partial shadow occlusion in the actual project, the system is unstable, and there are multiple peak points in the output characteristic curve. The global maximum power point cannot be tracked by using the conventional MPPT algorithm, and the maximum power cannot be output quickly and accurately in a short time. In this paper, a double integral sliding mode control method based on POC algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of multi peak global maximum power point tracking under partial shadow and the problem of slow response and large jitter of photovoltaic system. Simulation results show that this method improves the response speed and tracking accuracy of power tracking under partial shadow occlusion, and reduces the oscillation of output power.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Planning alongside Renewable and Gas Units for Carbon Goals
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the low-carbon transition of the power system, the penetration rate of renewables in the power system will continue to increase. The increase in the penetration rate of renewables will bring about the insufficiency of system flexibility resources. Compared with traditional coal-fired power units, gas units are more flexible in startup and shutdown, with lower carbon emissions. Therefore, in the process of transitioning to a high-proportion renewables system in future power systems, gas units should be considered to solve the problem of uncertainty of renewables output. In addition, energy storage serving as another major source of flexibility resources in the system will also play a major role in the system with a high proportion of renewables. This paper proposes a collaborative generation expansion planning model to decide the investment of wind power, gas units, and energy storage.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Power Sharing between Microgrids on the Usage of Renewable Energy and System Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to satisfy the future growth of energy demand and to utilize the unstable renewable energy (such as solar, wind, tide, etc.) power generation more efficiently, it is important to improve the utilization of renewable energy. In this paper, we focus on the impact of power sharing between autonomic decentralized coordination control (ADCC) based microgrids on energy efficiency and on system stability (outage time) under two scenarios (power sharing between on-grid and off-grid, and between off-off-grid). We built a DC bus connection switch based power sharing model between close microgrids in MATLAB/Simulink and simulate the interconnection scheme. At the same time, we considered different voltage levels of existing DC microgrids and carry out the power sharing between microgrids of different voltage. As a result, we achieve about 3.3 MWh of power being used efficiently in the on-off microgrid power sharing scheme in a year and the overall system stability in the off-off microgrid power sharing scheme is improved.

articleTitle: High-Voltage Cable Fault Detection Technology Based on Broadband Impedance Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of fault detection of high-voltage single-core cables, a new method of cable fault detection based on broadband impedance spectroscopy is studied. Firstly, the relationship between the wave impedance and the distributed parameters is deduced from the distributed parameter model theory of the cable, so as to obtain the key factors affecting the impedance. Then, the broadband impedance spectroscopy of the cable is measured by the linear resonance technique, and the characteristic data is analyzed and extracted from the impedance spectroscopy to obtain the relevant unknowns of the fault defect, so as to realize the cable fault detection. A 220kV cable fault is detected, and the analysis results show that the broadband impedance spectroscopy analysis can detect the cable insulation defects, and the fault location accuracy meets the engineering requirements. The given method can provide a technical reference for fault detection of transmission cables.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Gas Turbine Control System Based on Optimal Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The research on fault diagnosis method of gas turbine control system has important engineering application background and academic significance. In this paper, a fault diagnosis method for gas turbine control system based on optimized random forest algorithm is proposed. First, extract the eigenvectors of the fault data of the gas turbine control system. Secondly, select hyperparameters through Grid Search and Cross Validation to establish an optimal fault diagnosis model. Finally, the optimal model is used to realize the fault diagnosis of the gas turbine control system. The experimental results show that the method adopted in this paper can obtain the high-precision classification effect, and can meet the fault diagnosis requirements of the control system.

articleTitle: Clamped Split Delta-Source Inverter:Principles and Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the traditional Δ-source inverter (DSI) of large voltage spike of the switch and poor output power quality under high gain, a voltage clamping cell is added on the basis of the split Δ-source inverter (SDSI), and a clamped split Δ-source inverter (CSDSI) is proposed. Its topology and working states are studied, its steady-state boost characteristics and control strategy are analyzed. The new topology has the advantages of adjusting the duty cycle and modulation factor in the same direction, which is helpful to improve the output power quality at high gain. And the new topology can greatly reduce the voltage spike on the switches. The results of MATLAB/Simulink software simulation and the prototype experiments verify the performance of the converter, and prove the feasibility of it.

articleTitle: Harmonic Emission Level Prediction Method For Industrial Park Production Scenarios Considering Optical Storage Access
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the advancement of photovoltaics in the whole county, a large number of photovoltaics, energy storage and nonlinear loads have been connected to the power grid, and harmonic pollution has become increasingly serious. This method is based on the physical model characteristics of harmonic prediction, establishes an improved LSTM prediction network, and based on the Pearson coefficient, proposes a revised photovoltaic and The correlation correction index of user production scenarios realizes the classification of user production scenarios considering the impact of photovoltaic and energy storage on user production scenarios. Considering the cyclicality of production dates and the uniqueness of production scenarios in harmonic forecasting, the output gate of the forecasting model is improved. The prediction results show that this method is more effective for the prediction of harmonics, which is helpful for the optimal control of the photovoltaic energy storage system and taking measures in advance to control the harmonics and the power supply quality of the power grid.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Multi Converters in Future Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Synchronous operation of multi-converters is a necessary condition in the future power system dominated by converter interfaced generation. In this paper, three synchronization schemes are proposed: natural synchronization, power sharing based synchronization and fixed power based synchronization. The power sharing based self-synchronization is an improved vector-controlled power-synchronization control. The study system is constructed based on the modified IEEE WSCC system where all synchronous generators have been replaced by distributed VSCs. Load variation and generation variation are tested to validate the proposed synchronization mechanism and the time-domain simulation results have verified the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Adaptive Integral Sliding Mode Backstepping Control for Virtual Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of energy industry, it has gradually become a major trend for distributed generation and microgrid system to connect to large power grid through inverters. However, the power generation system with inverter interface lacks inertia and damping, which makes the stable operation of large power grid vulnerable to power fluctuations and system faults. In addition, uncertain factors such as system parameter measurement error, modeling error and external disturbance will also affect system stability. In order to solve the above problems, an integral sliding mode backstepping control scheme based on adaptive disturbance estimation technology is proposed. Firstly, adaptive law is introduced to estimate the system uncertainty. Then, an integral sliding mode backstepping control strategy is proposed to ensure the stable operation of the system and the smoothness of the grid-connected and off-grid processes. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed sliding mode backstepping control scheme based on adaptive disturbance estimation technology is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Optimal Siting and Sizing of Energy Storage Power Station Considering Peak Regulation Adequacy
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power and photovoltaic power generation, the lack of flexibility in peak regulation further affects the new energy consumption. In order to alleviate the peak regulation pressure of thermal power units, a comprehensive evaluation index of peak regulation adequacy and an energy storage power station planning method of high-voltage distribution system are proposed in this paper. The development margin of new energy and the growth of load during the planning period are taken into account. Both the economics of energy storage peak regulation and the adequacy of source-storage coordinated peak regulation are considered. The effectiveness of the proposed optimal method for energy storage power station siting and sizing has been verified in the modified IEEE 30-bus power system.

articleTitle: Electric Taxis in the Demand for Electricity Distribution Network Impact Analysis in Power Station
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, electric vehicles cannot achieve instantaneous energy replenishment. Although fast charging technology takes less time, it still cannot fundamentally solve the conflict between "range" and "battery capacity". Public utility companies have proposed the operation mode of electric vehicle charging and switching stations.
