In the construction and operation of switching stations for electric cabs (an important part of urban public transportation), although a certain number of switching stations have been put into use, there is a lack of research on the analysis of cab switching power demand and the optimal planning of switching station capacity, and the reasonable allocation of resources cannot be realized in the construction and operation of switching stations. In order to solve this problem, this paper analyzes the switching power demand of electric cabs. The main method is to analyze the GPS data of fuel cabs operation by using the data mining method to get its operation law. And this is used as the basis for the construction and operation of electric cab switching stations to get the electricity demand of different scales of switching cabs. The research can greatly promote and guide the construction and operation of the distribution network power station.

articleTitle: The Optimization Method of Voltage Reactive Power Operation of Distribution Network Based on SSAPSO Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of poor local search ability and low search accuracy of the traditional particle swarm optimization (PSO) in large-scale search, while takes advantages of good global exploration, good local development capabilities and fast position update of sparrow search algorithm (SSA), integrates SSA algorithm with the traditional PSO algorithm to construct the SSA-PSO fusion algorithm, to optimize the voltage reactive operation of distribution network. Compared to the traditional PSO algorithm, the result of voltage reactive optimization is better, and the operation is faster.

articleTitle: A Method for Preventing and Controlling Voltage Sag On Grid Side Considering Economic Benefits
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of voltage sag, a method for preventing and controlling the voltage sag on the grid side is provided. Through the analysis of the correlation and conflict between the investment cost and economic loss in the prevention and control of voltage sag. An optimization model considering the voltage sag prevention scheme by reducing short-circuit faults on the grid side. Taking the IEEE 30 node system as an example, the genetic algorithm is used to simulate the model, and obtain the specific prevention scheme of the corresponding line.To achieve the purpose of reducing the investment cost of voltage sag prevention and control, and reducing the annual economic losses of voltage sags suffered by sensitive users of the entire network.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Operation Cost Modeling of Power System Considering Wind Power Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Large scale random and intermittent wind power integration will significantly increase the additional operation cost of power system, and the variation characteristics are complex and difficult to accurately quantify. Different from the existing work, this paper first proposes a double-layer clustering method for wind power fluctuation scenarios. Secondly, a production simulation model of new energy power system is established to generate a comprehensive, real and representative sample set of power system operation cost. Finally, a data-driven mapping model between wind power fluctuation and the operation cost of power system and thermal power unit is established by using deep neural network algorithm. The proposed method can accurately simulate the variation trend of power system operation cost in different seasons and wind power fluctuation scenarios. The results show that the simulation error of thermal power unit and total system operation cost can reach 3%-13% and 4%-18%. This work provides insights and policy guidance for improving the wind power consumption rate and power system cost.

articleTitle: Study on Steady-State Voltage Distribution of Medium Voltage Distribution Network Considering High Proportion Distributed Photovoltaic Access
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Considering the influence of distributed photovoltaic access to distribution network on steady-state voltage distribution, this paper establishes a mathematical model of steady-state voltage distribution based on constant current static model. The effects of different variables (including access capacity, access location, etc.) on the steady-state voltage distribution during distributed photovoltaic access are analyzed under three different conditions: uniform load distribution, increasing load distribution and decreasing load distribution. The results show that the model can effectively analyze the impact of distributed photovoltaic single point or multi-point access on the voltage distribution of distribution network. It can guide the reasonable arrangement of the location and capacity of distributed photovoltaic access in the actual power grid planning.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Capacity Configuration Considering Transient and Steady-State Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increase of renewable energy permeability, system frequency characteristics under the disturbance gradually deteriorate. The randomness, intermittence, and fluctuation of the renewable energy output power lead to consumption problems. Based on power system transient and steady-state constraints, the objective function of this paper is to minimize the energy storage capacity required by the power system. Under the condition of satisfying both transient and steady-state constraints, a calculation method of system energy storage capacity configuration is proposed. The proposed method analyzes the system energy storage capacity configuration requirements from different perspectives. It is beneficial to analyze capacity configuration from two aspects of power system security and stability operation and renewable energy consumption. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by the IEEE 30-bus system.

articleTitle: Preparation and Performance Research of Phase Change Cold Storage Materials for Air Conditioning Cold Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: CaCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>•6H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O was selected as the base material for research, and a new type of composite phase change cold storage material was prepared through the experiment, which is suitable for air conditioning cold storage. The mass ratio of this material is 82% calcium chloride hexahydrated + 5% methanol + 13 % glycerol, the phase transition temperature of this material is 10.4°C after DSC test, and the latent heat value is 120.75J/g, which is more suitable for use as air conditioner cold energy storage. And the new composite phase change cold storage material uses barium carbonate as a nucleating agent. When the addition amount of barium carbonate is 1.5% wt, the degree of supercooling is small and nucleation is easier.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Control Strategy of Wind Power / Hydrogen Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The bidirectional regulation functions of hydrogen storage system and supercapacitor can used to effectively suppress wind power fluctuation and improve wind power consumption ability. In this paper, the structure of wind power / hydrogen integrated system coupled to the DC bus is firstly constructed, and the mathematical model of each unit is established. To improve the wind power consumption ability using hydrogen storage system, the coordinated control strategy for the integrated system is proposed. Based on the actual operation state of the system and the load demand of the power grid, the integrated system is divided into 10 operation modes. Under the condition of ensuring the safe operation of the system, the reasonable energy distribution for system energy balance is realized and the utilization rate of wind energy is therefore improved. Finally, PSCAD / EMTDC software is used to build the simulation model of wind power / hydrogen integrated system. The simulation results show that the coordinated control strategy proposed in this paper can effective smooth the wind power fluctuation and improve the wind power consumption ability.

articleTitle: Impact of Transformer Winding Configuration on Harmonic Stability of Grid-Connected Inverters: Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The grid-connected inverter (GCI) is connected to the power grid through the step-up transformer. This paper finds out that the commonly used YD11 transformer will introduce -30° phase lag in the current control (CC) loop gain of the GCI, which would jeopardize the system stability. To tackle this challenge, a phase angle compensation (PAC) algorithm is proposed to offset the phase lag introduced by the transformer, with which, the stability of the GCI is improved. Time-domain simulations are given to verify the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed PAC algorithm.

articleTitle: Maximum Energy Tracking and Precise Control of MLS-Based Wave Energy Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The emerging magnetic lead screw (MLS) has been proven to be efficient in wave energy conversion. However, the translator and the rotor are not connected rigidly, thus making it difficult to control the translator speed and displacement precisely. In this paper, the non-linear dynamic model is established and a relative speed compensation strategy is proposed to control the translator speed precisely and thus more energy is harvested. Additionally, a novel instantaneous curve fitting method is proposed to estimate the wave excitation force and equivalent frequency. Numerical simulation results have verified that the proposed relative speed compensation method and wave excitation force estimation method are practical and that the wave energy converter operates at maximum power point.

articleTitle: Application of LSTM in Metal Temperature Forecasting for a 1000 MW Double-Reheat Coal-Fired Boiler
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Since more renewable energy is being incorporated into the electrical grid, coal-fired power units must operate flexibly rather than as base-load. Sharp changes in the reheat steam temperature during flexible operation of the secondary reheat units can cause thermal stress on the reheater, resulting in tube breakage or unplanned shutdown. To avoid the risk of this issue occurring, the operating temperature of the reheater should be precisely monitored in real time. A novel long short-term memory (LSTM) for predicting metal temperatures is developed using real operating data obtained from a 1000 MW doublereheat power plant boiler. The soot blower action signals are added for more accurate prediction. The results indicate that the LSTM has adequate accuracy. The root mean square error for the test dataset is 0.861 ℃, the mean absolute percentage error is 0.105% and the Pearson correlation coefficient between the actual value and the predicted value is over 0.979.

articleTitle: Research on GIS Circuit Breaker Monitoring System Based on RFID Temperature Measurement for Alpine Regions
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the insulation performance of SF6 gas is affected in the low temperature environment of GIS circuit breakers in alpine regions. A GIS circuit breaker monitoring system based on RFID passive wireless temperature measurement is designed. The temperature field of GIS circuit breaker and temperature sensor is simulated and studied by COMSOL software, and the installation position of the sensor is determined. The RFID temperature measurement data gateway is developed to realize the data reading of 8 channels of RFID temperature measurement sensors at the same time. And upload the acquired temperature data to the remote server through WiFi or 4G to realize the real-time monitoring of the shell temperature of the GIS circuit breaker. The system has the characteristics of non-contact measurement, strong anti-interference ability and wireless data transmission. Has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Reactive Power Compensation Optimization for Power Grid with Large Scale Offshore Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Offshore wind power has a wide developing space in the future because of the increasing demand for green energy. In this paper, a multi-objective reactive power compensation optimization method of power grid integrated with large scale offshore wind farms is presented to optimize the capacity of reactive power compensation. The optimization objectives are considered including voltage deviation, voltage stability, active power loss and total reactive power compensation. Fuzzy optimization model is introduced based on fuzzy evaluation function and fuzzy analytic hierarchy process. Simulation results of Shandong power grid of China demonstrate that the proposed reactive power compensation optimization method can improve the voltage stability and economic effectiveness.

articleTitle: Optimization of Multi-temperature Joint Distribution Path for Cold Chain Logistics under Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The low carbon concept and low carbon economy have received more and more attention in scientific research. Considering that cold chain logistics with multi-temperature joint distribution produces higher carbon emissions in comparison with general cold chain logistics, we incorporate carbon emissions into the cold chain logistics distribution path optimization problem. We propose the total cost objective function consisting of transportation cost, penalty cost, refrigeration cost and carbon emission cost, and develop the minimum cost optimization model of cold chain logistics distribution path under multi-temperature joint distribution. And design and apply genetic algorithm to solve the model. By comparing the route optimization results before and after considering the carbon emission cost, the model can effectively reduce the distribution distance and thus the carbon emission, which proves that the multi-temperature joint distribution model is a cold chain logistics distribution model worth promoting.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Operating Status of Distribution Transformers Based on the Set Pair Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The distribution transformer fault mechanism is complex, and the data factors reflecting transformer operating condition information are numerous and uncertain. To this end, an index system is established based on engineering experience, and a two-layer evaluation model is established based on a combination of set-pair analysis and evidence theory fusion for distribution transformer operating condition assessment. The first layer of the model uses the set-pair analysis method to deal with uncertainty and generate the trust distribution function. In the second layer, the trust distribution function of each factor is fused with evidence and the conflicting evidence is processed to generate the final affiliation, and then the maximum affiliation principle is used to evaluate the operational status of the transformer in combination with the confidence criterion. After the example analysis, the validity of the method is initially verified, which can provide a new way of thinking for the condition assessment and maintenance strategy formulation of distribution transformers.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Ammonia-Fueled SOFC-ICE Hybrid Power System for Ship Application
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Increasingly stringent emission limits and carbon reduction needs of the shipping industry have forced shipowners and builders to look for alternative fuels and related power technology. Using ammonia to fuel solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) systems is one of the most efficient and environment-friendly technology options for the marine power. Considering the efficient utilization of exhaust gas and the effective integration of hybrid system, the combination of SOFC and other power technologies can achieve higher efficiency. In view of the current promotion of low-carbon/zero carbon fuel in the maritime industry and the integration of efficient and stable complementary SOFC and internal combustion engine (ICE) hybrid, it will be applied on ships in the future. Therefore, this paper designed an ammonia-fueled SOFC-ICE hybrid system for all-electric ship application. Based on MATLAB/SIMULINL, the steady-state electrochemical model of SOFC and the look-up table model of ICE about load were established. It is found that the electric efficiency of the ammonia ICE can reach about 30%. Based on a typical oil tanker, the ammonia-fueled SOFC-ICE hybrid power system achieves an electrical efficiency of 46.6% when the installed power density of the ammonia-fueled SOFC is 0.3 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the SOFC/ICE power ratio is 70-30.

articleTitle: Operation Optimization of Wind-solar Complementary Hydrogen Production System Based on MOGEO
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The preparation of "Green hydrogen" from renewable energy is an important way to realize low carbonization of energy. In this paper, the wind-solar renewable energy hydrogen production system, which is located in Chongli, Hebei Province, is used to power the hydrogen buses for the Winter Olympic Venues. Aiming at the shortcomings of Cplex solving multi-objective problems, an optimization strategy using multiobjective Golden Eagle algorithm (MOGEO) to solve the solution set of the optimal operation scheme is proposed, in order to achieve to maximize system profit at the same time reduce the environmental cost. Finally, the proposed method was compared with Cplex and MOPSO to verify the feasibility and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Decision-making Model for Integrated Energy Service Provider Considering Multi-energy Consumers’ Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With rapid development of multi-energy complementarity technologies, integrated energy service has gained increasing attentions and integrated energy service providers (IESPs) will become active trading entities in energy markets. To examine the impacts of multi-energy consumers’ demand response (DR) on IESPs’ trading strategies, this paper proposes a bi-level decision-making framework for an IESP to provide electricity and natural gas services for consumers taking into account uncertainties in wholesale electricity market prices. In the upper-level model, the IESP maximizes its conditional robust profit under a given confidence level, and determines energy procurement strategy and DR incentives to consumers. The DR incentives include the compensation prices for consumers’ load shift and the dynamic retail prices. In the lower-level model, according to the DR incentives, each consumer makes DR decisions including both electricity load shift from peak time to valley time and electricity load shift to gas load, to minimize its comprehensive cost including the discomfort of energy use. Numerical examples are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model. It is shown that by making full utilization of the multi-energy consumers’ DR capability, the IESP can achieve greater profitability in energy trading and reduce risk caused by uncertainties in wholesale prices.

articleTitle: Research on Equivalent Modeling Method of Multiple New Energy Stations for Sub/Supersynchronous Oscillation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing use of power electronics in the power system year by year, more and more new energy stations are connected to the AC system on a large scale, which also brings new stability problems such as wide-band oscillation. When carrying out detailed modeling and simulation analysis of such power systems, it will face the problem of "dimension disaster". At present, there is a relatively mature method for the internal aggregation equivalence of a single new energy station. However, it is very difficult to further aggregate equivalence for multiple stations, because there are significant differences in the parameters of units of different manufacturers and models, and the influence of electrical distance is caused by the collection of booster transformers and transmission lines in different stations. Starting from the specific analysis requirements of sub/supersynchronous oscillation, this paper adopts the frequency domain impedance method to study the equivalent method of multiple full-power converter-type new energy stations.Firstly, the frequency domain impedance characteristics and key parameters of a single new energy station are analyzed, and the key indicators of station grouping and aggregation are proposed;Secondly, the parameter calculation method of the equivalent unit is studied, and the feasibility of using one or more equivalent units to perform the multi-station equivalent value is analyzed; Finally, a specific example is established, and the feasibility of the proposed equivalent modeling method is verified by impedance analysis in the frequency domain.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Risks Analysis and Protective Measures of Ammonia as Marine Fuel
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: According to International Maritime Organization (IMO) requirements of greenhouse gas emission reduction, the application of zero-carbon fuel in ships is imperative, and ammonia as fuel is considered to be one of the best choices. However, the application of ammonia fuel is limited because of the safety risk of ammonia, especially its toxicity. Therefore, considering the liquid ammonia has been widely used in industry, this paper analyzes the safety requirements and protective measures for ammonia as marine fuel from the design point of view, aiming at the risks of ammonia and according to the existing requirements of relevant regulations in cargo, refrigeration and Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) systems, and puts forward suggestions for the safety protection of marine ammonia fuel. It also provides reference and support for the design and application of ammonia fuel powered ship.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Station – Centered Regional Virtual Aggregation Technology in the Traffic-electricity-communication Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electric vehicle interconnects traffic, electricity, and communication systems on account of its charging and intercommunication requirements. It causes the overlap of load hotspots in multiple systems and exacerbates the shortage of regional power supply. Firstly, this paper proposes a virtual aggregation mode to aggregate distributed resources and loads with charging station as the core node. Secondly, the constraints in both electricity networks and communication networks are built to develop the dynamic virtual aggregation strategy. Thirdly, case studies are conducted based on the real data of traffic-electricity-communication network in an area of Shanghai. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed technology are verified.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Fault Line Selection Method For Shore Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The reliable operation of the shore power supply system greatly affects the reliable power supply of the entire shore power system. However, due to the complex topological structure of the shore power supply system, the changeable operation mode, and the numerous lines, fault detection is difficult. The correct rate of line selection of various fault line selection devices currently used is not high. This paper proposes a single-phase-to-ground data driven fault line selection method for small-current grounding systems based on big data. First, the algorithm accesses and stores the big data related to the failure of the onshore power supply system. The raw data is processed into feature data using preprocessing and feature extraction techniques. Then, the big data mining algorithm is used to mine the mapping association between data features and fault lines. Finally, the mapping relationship is used for line selection, and an advanced big data mining algorithm based on massive and multi-dimensional fault-related data is proposed to improve the accuracy of line selection.

articleTitle: Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Prediction Algorithm Based on Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, photovoltaic power generation is becoming more and more important in the field of new energy power generation. The traditional BP neural network algorithm is prone to fall into local extreme points in the training process of the short-term photovoltaic power prediction model, and the training model If the global optimum is not reached, the optimization is stopped, and the weights of the initial network are randomly selected, which leads to problems such as low model prediction accuracy and low iteration efficiency. This paper proposes a short-term photovoltaic power prediction algorithm based on improved BP neural network. The method uses the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm to replace the traditional gradient descent method for training, which improves the iterative speed of the traditional BP neural network training, and uses the genetic algorithm to optimize the initial weight of the network model, which further improves the model prediction accuracy. The simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of the improved algorithm for short-term photovoltaic power is significantly better than that of the algorithm before the improvement, and the stability and iterative efficiency are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Integration Planning of 5G Base Stations and Distribution Network: A Perspective of Cyber-Physical System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes an integration planning of 5G base station (5G BSs) and distribution network (DN) from a perspective of cyber-physical system. Firstly, an interaction model of 5G BSs and DN is introduced considering both the physical and cyber characteristics. Then, we adopt the interval optimization to cope with the multiple uncertainties in the system and construct a multi-objective interval optimization (MOIO) model. This model aims to minimize the total cost and carbon emissions simultaneously. To solve this MOIO model, an interval multi-objective optimization evolutionary algorithm considering constraints (IMOEA-CC) is established, which can retain all uncertain information in the solution process. The analysis of numerical shows that the effectiveness of the integration planning model and the IMOEA-CC method.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Diagnosis Algorithm for the Fuel Injection System of Marine Two-Stroke Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The fuel injection system plays an important role in guaranteeing the diesel engine’s power and emission along with its economical and safe usage. Current research focuses mainly on the four-stroke diesel engine, where fault diagnosis is conducted through measuring the running parameters of the fuel injection system followed by the analysis of the running conditions via feature extraction. Few studies focus on fault diagnosis for the fuel injection systems of two-stroke diesel engine. Thus, this paper investigates this domain by using three artificial intelligence algorithms: the back-propagation network, the self-organizing feature map network and support vector machine. Experimental results on the marine two-stroke diesel engine demonstrate that the support vector machine can classify the working conditions more accurately and efficiently in the case of limited samples. The accuracy rate of fault diagnosis can reach 95% when the parameters of this algorithm are optimized via the grid optimization method.

articleTitle: Fire Accident Simulation and Fire Emergency Technology Simulation Research of Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery in Prefabricated Compartment for Energy Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to establish a reliable thermal runaway model of lithium battery, an updated dichotomy methodology is proposed-and used to revise the standard heat release rate to accord the surface temperature of the lithium battery in simulation. Then, the geometric models of battery cabinet and prefabricated compartment of the energy storage power station are constructed based on their real dimensions, and applied to the simulation of fire accident. Three stages: initial heating stage, flame generation stage and flame propagation stage, were observed and corresponding characteristic parameters were obtained from the fire accident simulation. Finally, the fire emergency technology include fire alarm and water mist fire extinguishing system were studied. The results show that the infrared beam linear smoke detector can give the fastest warning response to the fire. Besides, the optimal parameters for water mist fire extinguishing system were obtained. The research results can not only provide reasonable methods and theoretical guidance for the numerical simulation of lithium battery thermal runaway, but also provide theoretical data for safety fire protection design of electrochemical energy storage station.

articleTitle: Cooling Effect of Minimum Fresh Air Volume on a Super-Long Poultry House in Early Winter
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, the cooling effect of minimum fresh air volume on a super-long poultry house in early winter were studied by means of numerical simulation and field measurement. The results show that in addition to the mechanical negative pressure suction principle, the thermal buoyancy flow caused by layers’ heat dissipation and obstacle caused by cage rows and layers also have a strong influence on the air flow in the poultry house. The combined effect of them is to form tow reverse vortexes which all rise in the middle and sink along both side walls. As the relative strength of both driving forces is different at different location, the distribution of both airflow and air temperature is very uneven in both horizontal and vertical directions. Meanwhile, affected by the thermal buoyancy flow and blocking, the wind speeds of the windows on both side walls also vary greatly, with a standard deviation of approximately 0.41 m/s. A series of windows in the thermal-buoyancy-flow-dominated area can not even let in outdoor fresh cold air but can only partially eliminate the rising hot air, which is adverse to air exchange and cooling in the house. This phenomenon is obviously different from the traditional theory that the inlet speed of each window is approximately equal when mechanical exhaust is used. As a result, the traditional theory can not be used to guide the ventilation design and operation management of a super long poultry house featuring high flock density when the minimum ventilation volume is used in early winter.

articleTitle: Learning-based Solar Power and Load Forecasting in DC Net-zero Energy Building with Incomplete Data
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To cope with global climate change and carbon emission reduction, net-zero energy building (NZEB) was advocated in the building industries in these years, which aims to minimize energy needs and achieve zero-energy balance through renewables generation. Practically, because of the increasing energy demand and uncertainty in renewables generation, the building microgrid mostly relies on grid supply for daily usage instead of renewables generation, which violates the intention of zero energy. Thus, accurate load and PV power forecasting are imperative for NZEB power system planning. However, data-driven forecasting requires high volume of complete dataset. This paper compares load and PV power forecasting performance by learning-based models with incomplete data based on a demonstration NZEB project. The result highlights that Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) and Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory (BiLSTM) with K-nearest neighbors (KNN) interpolation on improvement of weekly load and PV power forecasting RMSE by 10.132 kW and 6.650 kW respectively.

articleTitle: Applicability Analysis and Combustion Simulation of Ammonia as Fuel for Marine Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to cut down carbon dioxide emission from shipping industries, ammonia is proposed as an alternative marine fuel oil recently. The applicability of ammonia as marine fuel is firstly analyzed in this paper in the aspects of carbon reduction potential, maturity system, infrastructure, and economy. It is proved and shows that ammonia fuel is one of the best alternative fuels for ships in the long term. To understand the feasibility of ammonia fuel as a clean alternative fuel for ships in the future, three-dimensional combustion model of a diesel engine 4135Aca was established by Solid Works software and CONVERGE software. The combustion simulation blended with ammonia fuel was carried out, so that the combustion characteristics in cylinder and emission characteristics out of diesel engine were obtained. When 1%, 5%, 8% and 9% ammonia is injected into air intake port, the combustion pressure and temperature inside cylinder will increase, due to extra work of the diesel engine, while CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission decreases by 18.7%, because of the delayed ignition time. These results indicate that the injection of ammonia fuel can increase diesel engine power and reduce CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions, but it also causes combustion delay and a little increase of NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</inf>, which should be paid attention to in the future application of ammonia fuel on board ships.

articleTitle: Research on Identification Method of Voltage Sag Type Based on MI-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate identification of voltage sag event types is the basis for sag location and treatment. Considering the full use of the voltage and current data when the sag event occurs, this paper proposes a voltage sag type identification method based on multi-input convolutional neural network (MI-CNN). In this method, the voltage and current data are input into the two input layers of MI-CNN respectively, and the features of the voltage and current data are extracted separately. Then the separately extracted data features are fused, and then the fused data features are further extracted. Finally, through several fully-connected layers, the classification results are output. In the simulation experiment, this paper tests three feature fusion patterns, and selects the feature vertical fusion pattern according to the optimal test results. Finally, the method proposed in this paper is compared with the other two classification methods, and the results show that the proposed method has higher identification accuracy and better anti-noise.

articleTitle: High Pressure Heater Fault Monitoring and Early Warning Based on PCA-XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and reliability of fault diagnosis of high-voltage heaters, a fault monitoring method based on historical data of thermal power units is proposed. Firstly, the principal component analysis method is used to extract the 6-dimensional features that have a great influence on the outlet water temperature of the high-pressure heater, and the data is normalized. Then the XGBoost algorithm is used to establish a fault monitoring model, and the method is compared with the random forest and GBDT algorithms. Evaluate the quality of the model by mean absolute error (MAE), root mean square error (RMSE) and coefficient of determination (R2). Finally, the model is verified by the data of the high-pressure heater in the fault state. The results show that the PCA-XGBoost algorithm has the best effect in predicting the outlet water temperature of the high pressure heater.Through the comparison of the temperature prediction curve and the continuous fluctuation signal of the residual curve, the fault warning is realized. It shows that the fault monitoring model proposed in this paper can give early warning to the fault of the high-pressure heater, and can improve the reliability of the system operation.

articleTitle: Research on the Interaction Mechanism of DC Side Ripple Based on MMC Wide Frequency Domain Model
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The DC voltage of the flexible DC transmission system is prone to the problem of excessive ripple during the transmission process, which leads to the instability of the system. The existing mathematical model of modular multilevel converter (MMC) is insufficient in the description of its internal harmonic dynamic characteristics, and cannot reflect the electrical coupling between the AC and DC sides of the MMC. Based on this, this paper proposes a wide frequency domain dynamic phasor model based on complex Fourier series, and studies the interaction mechanism between the frequency characteristics of MMC DC impedance and the switching frequency of its sub-module power devices. Finally, a single-ended flexible DC transmission simulation is built in Matlab/Simulink to verify the interaction mechanism between the DC impedance and the switching frequency of the sub-modules, which provides a reference for the DC voltage ripple problem in the actual flexible direct current transmission project.

Author Keywords: wide frequency domain dynamic vector model
